But as she continues her nerve-wracking duties of guarding the emperor, she starts experiencing troubling health symptoms. A trip to the doctor reveals that she's pregnant! To make matters worse, rumor has it that Kylart is looking for the mysterious woman he met on the night of the festival. Can Elan keep her secret safe from the entire palace, when she can't even control her constant cravings and morning sickness? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Flowers Find a Way to Bloom
description:
Between two rivals, love finds a way.

Nam Goong Yun is sickly with a bad temper. He wakes up one day to find he has traveled ten years back in time into the body of Baek Mo Ran, whom he used to bully! The years pass, and Yun finally regains control of his own body. But the question remains: Where was Mo Ran during all that time?

(Source: Manta)

Sharing flesh for lunch? Very normal.

A world where people share their flesh. I give mine to others, and they carve a piece for me. It’s toxic corporate culture on another level — how long could you last in a workplace like this?

(Source: Manta)

A boy spent his school years being bullied, and his female teacher wouldn't help him. Years later, they meet again at a club and he still remembers those scars. It's time to take it out on her. Her punishment will be long and hard.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

University student Jaemin loves all things small and adorable, but his large height and timid nature make him shy away from expressing such interests. At his part-time job at a cafe, he meets a customer named "Jiwoon." Upon seeing his smiling face, Jaemin can't stop himself as he asks if he could touch him...!

Come see Joseon's hippest new spot! Mystery and romance take Cheongdam, the owner of a trendy shop in the middle of Joseon's hottest new area, by storm! Will she be swept off her feet by the dashing Eul Jiro, or his friend, the mysterious Yi Taewon? 

(Source: Manta)

One day, an unidentified flying object appears in the sky along with unknown insect-like monsters. A normal high school student, Seung-ho Yun, is trying to survive as well as find his family. Along the way, he is aided by a message that tells him the future that only appears in his head. As he moves on with that slight advantage, he finds out that there are others who are getting the same message as him. Will he be able to find his family? And where are the messages in his head coming from? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

3 women, 1 messy love triangle!

Geum-Hui has always felt safe and comfortable working at her best friend Tae-Ri's company. But everything changes when Bo-Ra comes and stirs things up — Tae-Ri suddenly goes into hiding, and Geum-Hui gets thrown into the middle of... a police investigation and a messy lesbian love triangle!

(Source: Manta, edited)

Yoon Baek is a typical young man who works part-time jobs to make a living. One day, he comes across a stray cat that leads him to a veterinarian named Jay Blythe. After realizing that he met him before in his dreams, he comes to learn that he's been selected by Jay to be his next prey. Yoon later finds out that his older brother who went missing a few months back was also eaten by Jay, the tiger, before he lead him to Yoon for the tiger's next meal. In order to escape the curse of the tiger, he must find another sacrifice. But the blurred lines in their relationship makes their fate growingly uncertain. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Chapter count includes a prologue.*

display_title: Are You Just Going To Watch?
description:
Sung-Jae, a young university professor, can only find peace in the staff bathroom. One day he hears moaning coming from the stall next to him, and sees his beautiful student doing it through a hole... 

 *"Don't just watch... Come in"* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Rom-comixxx is the one and only student club for comic book lovers at Turnon University. And as one might guess, the club treads a fine line between naughty and nice--a fact that appalls Sun-jung, a new member who is an aspiring romance comic artist. Nevertheless, Rom-comixxx is Sun-jung’s only link to the comic world, and it might shut down if they don’t find more members! Can she and the oddball club president recruit enough members to create the greatest (and spiciest) comic ever?! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her house falls to ruin, Abigail Dilloa is relegated to serving an imprisoned princess for the rest of her life. Just as she finally comes to terms with her fate, assassins murder the sweet princess in cold blood. Faced with the same grisly fate, Abigail's past regrets flash before her eyes, but she is saved at the last minute by Duke Lakiel de Edelgard. However, the cunning duke is hell-bent on revenge, and he gives her an ultimatum: die, or play the part of Princess Violeta in his sinister succession scheme. Now that she has become a puppet in this play, will Abigail manage to fool the world and steal the throne? Or, will the cruel politics of the palace expose her act as nothing but a sham? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*"I'll make a man out of you!"*

Ji-Hoon has a secret that keeps him from losing his virginity. His sister, Ji-Ah, goes out of her way to prepare a special lesson on sex for her brother. Will Ji-Hoon be able to pass her class and lose his virginity?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

My crush is shorter than me! 

Ha-Yan Yoon, a 17-year-old aspiring model, has been single her entire life. She believes her soulmate is out there, waiting for her. Then along comes a boy — a whole head shorter than her! — and suddenly, her world is pink and blooming with flowers. Could this be destiny? 

(Source: Manta, edited)

It’s hard to be the most sought-out shaman in the country. You either get dismissed as a fraud or bombarded with questions about the most mundane things. Eun-cheon doesn’t mind the job, though. The job comes with a guardian entity that keeps you loaded and protects you from demons; what's bad about that? However, an unfortunate misunderstanding drives the General away, depriving Eun-cheon of the comfy life he's gotten used to. Eun-cheon's determined to get the general back. Even if that means he has to sleep with the person who hates him the most, the Divine General’s direct descendant, Lee Do-rim. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

로터 데이트
*Note: Each story has a Prologue and 3 chapters.*

If anyone’s looking for proof that two people can have casual sex and stay friends, look no further than Choi Eui-hyun and Jung Min. First classmates, and now co-workers, the secret ingredient to this 9-year relationship may just be Min’s unique preferences in bed. As someone who has never needed a safe word for anything in his life, Eui-hyun often struggles with Min’s overwhelming demands. Min, on the other hand, sometimes feels frustrated by how much convincing Eui-hyun needs to get kinky with him. But they’ve already lasted nine years, so what’s nine more…right? Or will their differences ultimately drive them apart? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

"I just want to tell him how I feel!" 

Mi-Na has been planning on telling Yeo-Myung she likes him. But every time she goes to confess, something foils her plans. It turns out Yeo-Myung and Young-Woong, her best friend, were actually plotting to kill her. But why?! 

(Source: Manta)

Tae-Jun leaves his girlfriend Jeong-Hyun after having an affair with Yu-Ra. He later meets Mi-Na, the mayor's daughter. They decide to get married, and hires a maid. However, the maid who visited is none other than his first love, Jeong-Hyun...!?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

*The Waiting* is the fictional story of Gwija, told by her novelist daughter Jina. When Gwija was 17 years old, after hearing that the Japanese were seizing unmarried girls, her family married her in a hurry to a man she didn't know. Japan fell, Korea gained its independence, and the couple started a family. But peace didn’t come. The young family—now four—fled south. On the road, while breastfeeding and changing her daughter, Gwija was separated from her husband and son. 

Then 70 years passed. Seventy years of waiting. Gwija is now an elderly woman and Jina can’t stop thinking about the promise she made to help find her brother. 

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

What is a girl to do when her irresponsible brother gets the family in another bind, this time to the tune of half a million dollars?! 

Kim Shihyun hasn’t had an easy life and her brother isn't making it any easier. Luckily for Shihyun, she has a solution. She just has to give up a year of her life to her cold, heartless, ex-husband in exchange for the money. This is far from ideal but Shihyun has no choice but to take this offer. But will this mean her life will revert back to her being a doll, living and acting according to her ex-husband’s wishes? Or will she be able to somehow break out of her gilded cage and finally set herself free?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.*

This novel depicts the process of main characters Gong Seong-Hyeon and Chung Tae-Gyeong finding true love. Raised by parents in a loveless marriage, Gong Seong-Hyeong has a pessimistic view of love and marriage and only has superficial relationships. Meanwhile, love columnist Chung Tae-Gyeong sees love as a matter of "give and take" and gives love advice to others, but hasn't been able to find true love for himself. After several failed attempts free at love, two men with completely different attitudes and values eventually find true love with each other while growing together and accepting one another in their lives.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*I'm not here for love.*

Si-Yun's been crushing hard on his high school tutor, U-Hyeon, and finally works up the courage to confess to him after graduation. U-Hyeon's answer? "Let's be friends with benefits." One night, Gyeong-Hu sees Si-Yun and U-Hyeon about to kiss outside a motel, stirring up something within him...

(Source: Manta, edited)

display_title: The Old Man and the Snow Sprite
description:
The heartwarming tale of a winter wonderland.

This little snow sprite is looking for fun, friends, and a place where it belongs — and not even a grumpy old man can stop it! As winter deepens and the snow sprite burrows itself into his life, the old man discovers a joyous warmth that he could have never expected.

(Source: Manta)

After several visits from the Reaper, Dohyung's life is constantly under peril. Although Dohyung is saved by the goblin, and falls in love with him, he won't easily reveal his identity... What is the fate of these two heading towards two different moments in time?

Do-hyun is on the verge of dying every time due to Cha's constant gambit. Thanks to his guardian, a goblin, he barely manages to get through a crises. He falls in love with his guardian, but the goblin doesn't easily open up about identity or feelings... With two moments facing each other at different times, what is the fate of the two?

Arthur Groban, a new detective with the LAPD, is desperate to prove his ability despite being a rookie within the force. But with every case he is assigned, things look more and more bleak as the corruption in the shadows becomes ever more apparent. Feeling helpless, Arthur is almost ready to give up when he happens to cross paths with the mysterious and alluring Silas Moore. Silas is willing to pull some strings behind the scenes to help Arthur, so long as the detective gives him two things in exchange: his body, and his pride. The further Arthur goes for Silas, the more he will get in return. But how far is too far in the pursuit of justice? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count include 11 extra chapters.*

Perpetually hiding behind a smile to survive his cruel family and stifling college life, Kwon Hyeon is drowning in anxiety and despair. It’s not like he chose to be born into money, but between his father’s demands to uphold the family’s reputation and his classmates’ constant gossiping, the only respite he has is Baek Do-Won, his psychiatrist. But everything changes when the mysterious Do-Won inducts Hyeon into his secret other life. Infatuated with Do-Won and driven by his self-destructive instincts, Hyeon is drawn into a world of twisted desire and pleasure.

Hae-Sung and Ji-Woon were childhood friends that grew apart after Ji-Woon moved away. Reunited at college years later, the friendship is rekindled - but there’s no sexual chemistry to speak of. However, that all changes when Hae-Sung catches a glimpse of Ji-Woon’s package as he’s getting dressed. After the “big” reveal, Hae-Sung begins to view her hunky childhood friend in a new light!.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*

In the Kingdom of Jasmine, there lives a blacksmith named Anna Baker. Anna is highly skilled at making swords, and her work is much sought after - even the dashing Prince Alexander is a regular customer. One day, the Prince comes by the forge to pick up his new sword, but leaves the sheath behind! Anxious to find him, Anna hurries out into the deep, dark forest in pursuit… and that’s where her adventures begin!

(Source: Lezhin) 

*Note: Season 1 - 20 chapters*

I only have two years left to live.
With a smothering, toxic gray sky, life on earth is no longer the same. Io has been wearing a Purity Suit for 28 years, until he discovers that it had been defective his whole life. With only a couple of years left to live, he meets Joan, and his life starts to go in a new direction. 

(Source: Manta)

When Ein is brought in to the Marquess Howard’s manor, he finds himself serving TWO masters. Unaware of the tension between the two brothers, Ein seeks out ways to be as useful as possible. As he teaches the naïve Collin during the day and gives his body to the Marquess at night, Ein will find his eagerness to serve... put to the test. While one may lay claim to his body—for now—which master will be the one to claim his heart? 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: includes six special episodes.*

Two childhood friends, Eunchae and Jiho, decide to hit each other with a backscratcher to beat away bad luck. And why not? Nothing weird about a couple guys doing favors for each other — you scratch my back and I scratch yours! But sometimes it takes a hard hit to knock some sense into you... or some feelings into your body. Some very good feelings. As their bodies suddenly react to each new bump in their relationship, will their hearts also be tied together? For good luck, knock on wood! 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Unbeknownst to them, Min and Hyunwoo have been in one another's life since they were little. Min is a TV producer who has been demoted to the entertainment division for defending his colleague. Hyunwoo is a K-pop idol who has fallen from grace after his controversy over an assault against a fellow idol. The two lost souls develop feelings for each other while producing a variety show.

(Source: NETCOMICS)

Getting divorced is hard. But continuing to live with your ex-wife for her sick father is even harder. Still, it's a bit easier when you get to have her, and keep seeing the other beautiful women in your life.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

*"I like you. I don't want to remain as owner and pet, but I want to be lovers."* 

Hae-sin Baek enters a convenience store with a friend and is abruptly kissed by part-timer Won Choi. Shocked, Haeshin avoids him, but Won is persistent and reveals his secret that Haeshin is his savior. 

Will Won, a werewolf that commits their whole life to one owner, be able to make his puppy love come true? 

(Source: Copin Comics)

Hakyung's long-time crush was his boss, Hyunsoo Jang. Without appealing to his secret crush, he's been seeing any man who resembles his boss. But one night, he was offered by his perfect boss an unusual offer, "Be my sex partner", how should Hakyung manage this relationship? 

(Source: Pocket Comics) 

*Chapter count includes 5 special chapters and an April Fools Day special Chapter*

Everyone has memories of their first love. For Dong-Ha, however, his first love only ended in regret. In high school, Dong-Ha’s feelings were reciprocated by his crush Sung-Wu, but Dong-Ha avoided his first love for fear for losing his friends if they found out about his sexuality. It wasn’t until later that he tried to express his true feelings, but by then Sung-Wu had disappeared from his life. As Dong-Ha remains remorseful of hurting his first love, One day he receives a package from Sung-Wu. Inside is a novel titled, “Memories of Sorrow from Gyeongseong.” After reading the book, Dong-Ha finds himself sucked into its fictional world. And there he meets novel’s version of Sung-Wu. This time, Dong-Ha vows to never lose his first love again… Two lovers reunited during the Japanese occupied Korea, will they be able to find each other this time? 

(Source: Lezhin)

Whenever he steps foot outside, Do-Jun is faced with an unexpected challenge – the seemingly never-ending public displays of affection from his next-door neighbors! But the fact that they’re both men means that Do-Jun’s discomfort quickly earns him the label of homophobe. Determined to break free from stereotypes, Do-Jun attempts to bridge the gap by reaching out to his neighbor, only to find himself entangled in far more than neighborly relations.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five side story chapters.*

Chae-Yi ended up staying at the home of Gun-Woo, a close friend who had eloped with his girlfriend to avoid a family custom. As she enjoyed her solitary hours, soaking in the bathtub and watching the Manhattan night scene, she didn't know that a man was approaching her...

*"You approached Noh Jae-Hyuk to jump into bed with him, didn't you?"
"That's the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard!"
"Does that sound like a lie to you?"*

There’s no doubt that Choi Hyun is a dedicated son. There’s nothing he hasn’t tried to get his parents to feel better, who have fallen under a mysterious illness. But even the most renowned doctor in the village can’t seem to help. As a last resort, Hyun climbs the mountains looking desperately for the “guardian tree” that the local shaman told him to seek out. And when he finally comes to find it, he discovers that the tree is home to a mythical being called the Kirin. Kirin, or rather, Tak-myung certainly is powerful enough to bring Hyun’s parents to full discovery, but he wants something in exchange from Hyun… And while Hyun is willing to make a deal, there are some other more darker forces that have their eyes set on the Kirin and his mythical powers…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Christmas. Hotel. A special day, a secret story in a special place. We didn't know what you'd like, so we prepared a bit of everything.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

 **Release includes:**
1-3. **Namsachin Sayongbeop** (남사친 사용법, How to Use Male Friends) by Sao
4-7. **In the Hotel, in the Body** (인더호텔 온더베드) by Rako
8-10. **My X-MAS Report** (마이 X-MAS 리포트) by Geumgal. *Boys' Love.*
11-13. **Bisanggyedan** (비상계단; Emergency Stairs) by Mamo. *Boys' Love.*
14-17. **Christmas Revenge** (크리스마스 리벤지) by Golji
18-22. **Santa-ga Jakku Sowoneul Deureojundago Hamnida** (산타가 자꾸 소원을 들어준다고 합니다; Santa Keeps Saying He'll Grant My Wishes) by Merin. *Boys' Love.*
23-25. **Love Script** (러브 스크립트) by Jeo Si. *Boys' Love.*
26-28. **Punch Drunken Love** (펀치드렁큰러브) by Ginga. *Boys' Love.*
29-31. **Un-holy night** by Gangtto Key. *Boys' Love.*
32-34. **Daeum Seukejureun 2501Hoeseo** (다음 스케줄은 2501호에서; Next Meeting is in Room 2501) by Hui-Yeol Park

Outgoing and athletic, Da-Rim’s always surrounded by friends. But back in elementary school, she used to be a social outcast—she only started making friends when Tae-Hoo brought her into the fold. Now in high school, the two have drifted apart, but Da-Rim is waiting for a chance to reunite with her icy Prince Charming. There’s just one issue: Da-Rim's body transforms into a boy’s at noon every day, only to turn back at midnight! Well, if she can’t get close to Tae-Hoo as a girl… Why not try as a boy?! 

(Source: Lezhin)

Outed in high school?!

In the middle of the night, high schooler Jung-Yoon sends a teary text to her ex-girlfriend in the hopes of winning her back. But much to her horror, she discovers that she's actually sent it to Do-Young, the most anti-social girl in her class! Will she be outed at school?!

(Source: Manta)

Jihoon’s always working. He needs to--there’s rent to pay, tuition to take care of, and hospital bills that need to be sorted out. His money problems don’t end when he gets into university, but he soon finds a way to pull himself up by his bootstraps. His part-time job at the girl’s dorm introduces him to a bunch of rich, spoiled, and sexy girls…all of whom want to have their way with him. Why would he say no? It’s his chance to climb up the social ladder, as well as sleeping with the most alluring girls in the school!

(Source: Lezhin X)

For Haesoo, the idea of a demanding, sexually aggressive “queen” has always felt more appealing than being “king” himself. But when he thinks he’s finally met someone who can turn that dream into reality, he discovers that it’s not a woman who’s waiting to dominate him but another guy… Is this the sexual fantasy that Haesoo has always been after? Can Haesoo handle being pushed far beyond his limits? Check out the newest BL comic from the author of “An Innocent Sin” and “Temptress”! 

(Source: Lezhin)

After quitting his job just to end up scammed out of all his money, Yim Sang-Tae's at the end of his rope! He hangs around a luxurious apartment building and throws himself at the first rich person he sees, begging for a meal. But his savior, Mo Yeon-Woo, asks how Sang-Tae will pay him back. When Sang-Tae states he'll use his body, intending to do manual labor, Yeon-Woo agrees and they wind up in bed together! Will Sang-Tae and Yeon-Woo find happiness in their sudden encounter, or will Sang-Tae's debts catch up to him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

Smart, clever, and resourceful, Daon worked hard to overcome being poor. But his cheap ways are getting on the last nerve of his coworker, Sung-Hyeon, who hates him! After an incident with his own impoverished parents, Da-On is suddenly growing closer to Sung-Hyeon while balancing feelings for his former tutor, Jae-Min. With mixed emotions and unspoken secrets, will Da-On be rich with love or fall back into poverty? 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters.*

Kim Pyeong-Beom is an ordinary person who lives a common life, but one day an alien with the appearance of a teddy bear lands in his room! From that moment on, he will accept that intercultural exchange with BR, the fifth prince of Planet KKRY… But how will he end up becoming the prince's sex education manager too?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Min-Hyuk's life takes an unexpected turn when he meets Sun-Woo, a quirky yet irresistibly cute guy he ends up living with by chance. At first, Sun-Woo's antics drive him crazy, but soon, his charm begins to grow on Min-Hyuk. Just as Min-Hyuk starts to enjoy their unusual cohabitation, Sun-woo drops a bombshell confession that turns his world upside down. With his peaceful life in turmoil, Min-Hyuk must navigate his feelings and the unexpected twists that come with living with someone as unpredictable as Sun-Woo. Will he be able to resist Sun-Woo's charms, or is he destined to fall for him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count contains 3 side story chapters.*

*“I want you♥for my birthday gift.”* 

On his 20th birthday, Joosuh Yoo declares he wants his long-time neighbor Hyunwoo Kang's body. Hyunwoo expresses that Joosuh's too young for him, but the passionate and headstrong Joosuh persists and Hyunwoo gives in for one night. After their night together, Hyunwoo continues to treat Joosuh like a child. 

Joosuh enrolls into college and is thrown into a new life. Hyunwoo is shocked after witnessing that Joosuh, despite being the kind kid Hyunwoo has ever known, is a total social pariah. When Hyunwoo asks why Joosuh isn't friendly to others, Joosuh remains steadfast. 

*“You're all I need.”* 

Hyunwoo has known the kid next door for a long time, but contemplates over how to take Joosuh's obstinate character to cling onto one single person. 

Will Joosuh be able to win over Hyunwoo's heart?

(Source: Copin Comics)

She’s the perfect private tutor—smart, beautiful, and willing to offer more thanjust extra lessons. For her top-scoring students, the reward goes far beyond grades… and once you get a taste, you’ll do anything to stay at the top of the class.

(Source: Toomics)

The day of his older brother's funeral, Ho-il meets the mysterious Sangyeon and feels an immediate attracttion to him. However, it turns out that Sangyeon used to be Ho-il's brother's boyfriend, leading to a complicated relationship between the two men. However, something beautiful beyond their expectations just might bloom from their shared grief and affection. 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes seven side story chapters.*

*“I would like to go back in time one year. I lost someone important to me then.”* 

That’s what workaholic Eunkyeol Jung wishes one Christmas at a mysterious bar, as she laments being dumped by her boyfriend a year ago. And against all odds… her wish comes true! Unfortunately, she still gets dumped, but this time around she saves her best friend’s brother Yiyool from a tragic death. He even becomes her coworker! With this time to do over and without the love life she hoped for, will Eunkyeol find unexpected happiness or another year of heartbreak? 

(Source: Tapas)

Michael, a loser in a big corporate job is in a rut, but everything changes when his bully from high school proposes a business deal to him as a broker.

(Source: Toomics)

Lee Junseo is a poor Omega photographer who meets the rich Alpha CEO, Choi Changwoo. Believing that they are a match, Changwoo organized a marriage contract in exchange for money. With the two having many contrasts, will the relationship turn into something more than a contract? 

(Source: INKR)

display_title: The Tiger That Swallowed the Moon
description:
Taebom Gwak, an Olympic gold medalist of the national shooting team, suffers a dangerous hit-and-run accident. The person who he used to call "Daddy-Long-Legs" suddenly appears in this life-or-death situation, ten years after he's disappeared from Taebom's childhood. But he is actually… a vampire?!

(Source: Manta)

Haeyo can’t help herself - she gets aroused whenever, wherever. Whether she’s on her way home, in the gym, or in a bar, she’s ready to entice anyone who’s brave enough to accept her advances. Equipped with a sultry stare, she woos unsuspecting targets who can't say no after getting a glimpse of what she has to offer. Well... Are you ready to get tempted?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Hong Jin-Ju and Ji Su-Jeong couldn't be any more different. Jin-Ju is bubbly, popular, and more interested in hanging out with friends and chasing women than worrying about school. On the other hand, Su-Jeong is quiet and reserved, relying on her good grades to earn her scholarship money to afford her tuition. Contrary to her closed off and frigid appearance, Su-Jeong is secretly the model and muse for the lingerie company, “Goodnight Cinderella.” Jin-Ju is drawn to the mysterious nature of Su-Jeong and wants to get to know her better, meanwhile Su-Jeong is keen to stay away and protect her secrets. Watch as the juicy drama unfolds on campus.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

My husband's strange friend is living with us…

On a hot summer's day, Sanghyun's wife is approached by Ingyu, an old friend of her husband's. Although she is wary of his eerie looks and strange demeanor, Ingyu quickly reconnects with her husband, moving in with the two soon after. But after they invite him in, strange things begin to happen… 

(Source: Manta)

Just as I was about to get into another ambiguous, half-hearted relationship, I met her. Hyun-Jin Go. I couldn't take my eyes off her. I had been treading a dull path, and she knocked me right off.
Then I felt it — a little piece of my heart, breaking off and slipping away.
"She's so pretty..." 

(Source: Manta comics)

Min Yeon-U goes on a blind date after being in a one-sided love for ten years. But the blind date … is the person who gave him a plastic surgery consultation a few years ago?!?!?! Will he put an end to Yeon-U’s ten years of unrequited love? 

“Doctor…! Can you operate on love too?!” 

(Source: Bookcube, translated) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.*

You don't know me. Got it? 

After a rough three years in middle school, Doeun decides to return to her hometown and attend high school there for some peace and quiet. But with her old besties now the hottest, most popular guys in school, that might be harder than she thought. Why can't everyone just leave her alone?! 

(Source: Manta)

A-Rim was returning home after work, drunk and wasted when a handsome man appears in front of her and introduces himself as a "Werewolf". He asks A-Rim if he can stay in her house for a while. Due to this wolf-man's request, A-Rim, and Ten begin their dynamic cohabitation. The gorgeous werewolf, Ten, is attracted to A-Rim's scent and chooses her as his "mate". A-Rim teaches Ten about the human culture and society and starts feeling some kind of warmth in her heart when she pends time with him. Will A-Rim eventually all in love with Ten?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

How awkward would it be to reunite with not one but two of your ex-boyfriends, and at the workplace nonetheless? When Nabom Han comes face-to-face with her unforgettable first love, Chajun, and her ex-boyfriend she hoped she’d never see again, Tae-o, she must learn to navigate the relationships from her past while ensuring the success of her father’s struggling manufacturing business. They say you should never mix business with pleasure, but will Nabom be able to resist the temptation? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hui-Un is the personal assistant of his childhood friend Geon-Ju, whose wealthy family took him in when he was a young boy. For years, he’s been nursing a crush on his friend and boss, but Geon-Ju seems to have no clue. Sounds like the stuff of BL romance, right? It turns out, Hui-Un’s life actually is. The night before Hui-Un is to start an odd new job for Geon-Ju, he comes across a strange BL novel where the main characters have their names. It’s a funny coincidence...until it’s got Hui-Un yelling, *“Quit Writing, Dear Author!”* 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

After her show, singer and radio host Ban Ha-Na receives a cassette player from a fan. But being just one among many gifts, she doesn’t think much of it-- that is, until the press of a button sends her to the 80s! There, she meets the cassette player’s owner, who happens to be the late musician U Jae-A. However, Ha-Na meets him at a time when he hasn’t yet become famous and is on the verge of quitting music. Will she be able to convince her idol not to give up on his dream and save his life?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Taeha Oh loves to write smutty BL stories online. Why? 'Cause it's fun. Though he insists he's definitely not gay himself. But will things change after a surprise reunion sparks something inside of him…? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: Chapter count includes two special chapters.*

Living with a sexy landlord, and even sexier neighbors is just so fun! Enjoy a night full of lust!

*"Hey... You are the only guy here."*

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jin-Ho, a jobless loser, is jealous of the handsome streamer who invites sexy girls on his stream every night.

*"I wish I could be him, just for a day!"*

And... it happened?!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Ga-Yeon knows what men want. She knows what it takes to fulfill their fantasies, and loves the power that comes with the conquest of even the most arrogant of men. Nothing can strip her of that confidence. Not even a sudden warp to a foreign land, and not even the fact that she has to become a random emperor’s concubine. Why would that faze her? The emperor Zeros is good looking, has a hot bod, and acts aloof. He’s just the kind of man that she’s used to dealing with. It won’t take too long for her to make him hers…or will it?

(Source: Lezhin)

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*

On every campus prowl the foxes. You’ve seen them, right? The gorgeous girls who look all innocent, but will use every trick in the book to snare their prey. There might even be one sitting next to you right now… Indulge your fantasies with these tantalizing tales featuring the most cunning hotties you’ve ever set eyes on.

(Source: Lezhin US)

To become a god in bed, all you need to do is accept female guests into your guest house! 

(Source: Toomics)

An A-list actor and a rookie actor meet on the set of a TV show. “Did I… do well?”

A whirlwind romance that blurs the line between acting and reality! 

(Source: Manta)

Ma Ria is an ordinary office worker until one day, a god appears and fulfills her “earnest” wish. The god promises to stay by her side and grant her a single wish every day until Ria, who has no faith in mankind, learns to love humanity. But when the god grants even her unconscious wishes, a series of unforeseeable events occur—leading to death, disaster, and chaos. Will Maria finally learn how to love humanity or will she destroy the world in the process? 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

After years of slacking off, Sun-ki decides to get his act together and find a job. Strong, virile and good with his hands, he finds a position that’s perfect for him: swimming pool maintenance guy at the local women’s university! But when the girls on the college swim team are this hot and horny, perhaps the pool won’t be all he ends up servicing… Join Sun-ki as he gets wet ’n’ wild with these busty beauties!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Having been outed at work, shoe designer Park Seok-Yeon is forced to start all over. He gets a new job at “Youm,” an up-and-coming brand with an accepting work environment and generous perks. It seems like the perfect company until Seok-Yeon finds out that the CEO is none other than his former crush, Jin Yeowon, the cold-hearted jerk who nearly drove him to end his own life. Now, they must work together, but will old feelings well up? Like a sudden downpour, love appears when you least expect it. 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Popular college student, Seung-Jae Lee's got it all, when it comes to wealth, connections, physique, but everytime he spends a night with a girlfriend, he immediately gets dumped. After one of these break ups, Seung-Jae spends the night drinking and on his way home runs into and catches up with Ui-Seong Kim, a friend from high school.
Seung-Jae drunk-confesses all of his problems and Ui-Seong convinces him to re-enact everything that he tried with his previous girlfriends, causing the two to end up having sex.
The next day, Seung-Jae realizes he did something crazy yet asks how last night was. Ui-Seong replies, “I don't know, maybe I'll know if you show me one more time,” tempting Seung-Jae again. 

Can Seung-Jae stay friends like old times while still having sex with Ui-Seong? But unexpectedly, Ui-Seong has a secret to reveal, but it's become a shade...? 

(Source: Copin Comics, edited)

Forbidden romance on the high seas! 

It was all smooth sailing for Lil Schweiz, a famous pirate captain, until some shocking news almost threw her overboard. The notorious Admiral Retiro, known for scalping and feeding his pirate captives to flesh-eating fish, is on his way... And he's coming for one thing only.

(Source: Manta)

Yeonsoo is a gentle swimming instructor for kids, content with the calm rhythm of everyday life—until top star Cha Juhwan suddenly walks into his pool, needing to master swimming fast for a film role. 

What starts as a professional arrangement quickly turns personal. Yeonsoo, shaped by years of gaslighting from a toxic partner, has come to believe he can only enjoy relationships that hurt. But Juhwan sees right through him, and offers something different—something kind. 

*"I’m used to getting hurt. My partner likes it that way."*
*"Then try it with me as well."*
*"I’m not talking about pain. I mean something real—something gentle."* 

With Juhwan’s quiet patience and unwavering honesty, Yeonsoo begins to realize that love doesn’t have to come with bruises. And maybe, just maybe, he deserves something softer. 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*

I'll be the one to save you this time. 

While suffering from PTSD, Roman Brennon searches for pianist Yu-Ri Jung's album. He finds it in a small store, but it's sold before Roman can buy it. It is here that he runs into Yu-Ri himself, who has fallen ill and can no longer play the piano. Yu-Ri once saved Roman, but can he return the favor? 

(Source: Manta, edited)

"Let's kill your husband... so you can come live with me."

(Source: Manta)

Who wouldn't want to be a princess? You’d have maids at your beck and call, riches to indulge even your most unnecessary wants, and a dashing young prince who’d charm your socks off. But what if you became the villainess of a story? One day, Jae-eun wakes up as Sheilia Aidenrose, the notoriously cruel princess of “The Rose of Isonia.” As she knows all too well of Sheilia’s gruesome end (the novel was written by her sister, after all), Jae-eun is determined to take matters into her own hands. She won’t let Sheilia’s fate be dictated by the original novel! Little does she know that this means she’ll change the fates of all those involved, even that of the most minor characters... 

(Source: Lezhin)

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

Kiss more, win more!
Seung-A's a lifelong baseball fan, but she's on the verge of calling it quits. Her team, the Futures Victory, is on a notoriously long losing streak — until she kisses a fellow fan, and the Futures happen to win. Now back in the game, the two get intimate to push the Futures up the ranks...

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes an epilogue and 3 extra chapters.*

Yoo-An Ha, a high school senior, messed up his SATs because he mismarked his papers. He is approached by a foreigner- no, a demon who proposes to turn back time. In exchange, Yoo-An must stand in as the demon king's replacement... Will Yoo-An, living the demon king's life, be able to safely return to his own life? “Should I live however I want? I'm the real king until the real one returns!” 

(Source: Copin Comics)

When Sol receives an engagement party invitation from Minji, the girl who stole her first love, shes determined to attend just to prove how great she’s doing. But she needs to find a hot boyfriend first, when her dating lifes been nonexistent! The only viable candidate she can find is her younger brother’s friend, Joohyuk, who has had a major glow-up since his scrawny teenage years. “I’m not a little kid anymore. You’d better watch out.” The tall, sexy Joohyuk seems like trouble…but desperate times call for desperate measures. As long as she can see Minji’s jaw drop in shock, Sol is willing to put up with his demands. Little does she know that Joohyuk is actually out to get her for ruining his life in high school! Will Sol be able to make this rocky partnership work in her favor, or will the plan backfire on her? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Eun-hyeon is the promising young CEO of RedFit, a vastly successful gaming company. But while he’s got the looks and the status, he’s also a chronic workaholic with a mean mouth, and his employees are always busy avoiding him. His secretary, Ms. Han, is the only one who seems to be capable of dealing with his insensible remarks... But even she has her limits. Having had enough of his tyranny, she storms inside his office ready to quit - completely oblivious to the words that would soon come out of her irritable boss’ mouth. 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Wi Mokhwa was given another chance at life. Her first life had been worse than hell, therefore, at her untimely death, life came flowing back into her.

At fifteen, she fell in love easily and believed Lee Gajun to be her destiny. There wouldn’t have been anything more perfect for eternity. However, facing death, Wi Mokhwa had to accept her cruel end. Her life at fifteen had been futile and was where her misery started.

Regretting her life, she was given another chance. This time she has Lee Jejun's sincere feelings to protect her and stand by her side. He was willing to be her light even inside a dark world. This life was not doomed to fail.

Revenge, salvation, and a miracle.This is her true life, the second life where it all begins again.

To save one, she'll kill the other. 

A miraculous, 1-in-200,000 chance birth of conjoined twins. The probability of their survival? Less than 5%. Born with just one heart between the two of them, the Kang sisters face a sinister fate: for one to survive, the other must die. Their mother faces a horrible choice. How would you decide? 

(Source: Manta)

Brought together by fate.
Hyungbae is a bit of a workaholic. Underappreciated and overworked, he feels burnt out at his current job. Enter Deokbae, a carefree dog that has a mind of his own! Follow Hyungbae and his canine companion as they navigate the ups and downs of life, bringing a whole new meaning to the word "family."

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.*

After waking up to find himself in another world, he comes face to face with the prince of the kingdom, Daniel, who looks exactly like him. In return for saving his life, the prince asks him to play his stand-in, basically to become his 'shadow.' He accepts and with a new name and identity, Rael serves the prince by taking on any given tasks. But what will he do when he's asked to spend a night with the emperor of the realm...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Who knew being fake was a job?

Kyoungjin's new job is writing fake product reviews as the fictional blogger, "Lady Chatterley." And she's good at it. But one day, she receives a letter reading: “B's disinfectant spray poisoned my children. We started using it after reading your review...”

(Source: Manta)

While waiting for her friends on the street one day, university freshman and band music enthusiast Do Ah-Yeon reunites with former high school classmate Lee Hae-Rang, who's now... the vocalist of a band? Having only hung out with Hae-Rang once during high school to see a live show together, Ah-Yeon still has some unanswered questions about him... Why did he drop out of school after the show? How did he end up in a band? But most importantly, what does he think of her? 

(Source: Tapas)

Honam and Sooyeon have been together for four years. Sooyeon thought he knew everything there was to know about Honam, but Honam is actually a half-tiger, half-human just days before becoming fully human! Dajun, the owner of the place Sooyeon works, is actually a half-tiger, half-human that's given up on becoming a human...? What will become of Sooyeon suddenly stuck between these two tigers?

(Source: Copin Comics)

Feeling burned out from work, Yoo Eun decides to relieve stress through her one and only hobby: gaming. When the system update window appears floating in thin air in front of her, she suddenly finds herself being transported inside the game! With no means of escaping and desperate to survive in this strange new world, she manages to secure a job as a tailor at the boutique at 97 Sheldon Street, where she catches the attention of the mysterious noble Ashton Richmond. He says he will help her, but it’s almost as if he’s been waiting for her to show up the whole time… 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: I’ll be your dog starting today
description:
“What am I? The dog that stays by your side.”
The youngest son of the Chairman of one of the leading business groups in the country, Song Se-Yeon, grew up in a warm family. That is, until one day he loses his parents in sudden fire, and his only brother goes mad. When his whole world is crashing down on him, the Vice Chairman, Kim Su-Hyeok, appears as Se-Yeon’s guardian. In order to protect his family and his only brother, Se-Yeon chooses to become Su-Hyeok’s puppet...
Then, on his twentieth birthday, he receives a letter saying, "I’ll help you escape.”
As if bewitched by the promise of freedom, he visits the address mentioned in the letter, only to meet a mysterious man, Lee Hyun, who offers to be his master. 

(Source: Lezhin)

display_title: So What If the Dark Lord's a Goblin?
description:
Alex, vengeful Elf is on a vendetta against the so-called "Chosen ones" who keep the peace of the land ever since their ancestors vanquished the Dark Lord Gob-Khan a millennia ago.
Seeking to destroy the world that has betrayed her, Alex awakens the Dark Lord from his thousand-year-old slumber only to find that a goblin.
Will this pathetic little green creature manage to live up to his seemingly unjustified reputation and help Alex bring apocalypse upon the world? 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Having to lie about a nonexistent girlfriend to date a charming girl. Is this relationship going to work out?

(Source: Toomics)

Yoon Onghyeon has a hard time while working at a cafe called Season Cafe in Jeju. He resigns and then comes to the cafe because he trusts a senior of his, but it's about to close down. A man is surprisingly hired when they are about to give up saving the cafe, but what bothers Yoon Onghyeon is that the man is his ex-boyfriend who was abdoned by him. Facing the trouble of unemployment and bad relationships, will he succeed in both his career and love? 

(Source: Webnovel)

A mother goes to live with her daughter to fix their broken relationship. Unfortunately for her son-in-law, her mature, attractive looks drives him crazy. Living with her gets harder every day, and he's not the only guy after her...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

“Do you… remember?” Sihyeon Lee, entering school on one warm, spring day, bumps into “him”, someone he never wanted to see again…! Who’s the real protagonist of this story? 

(Source: Lalatoon)

It is every martial artist's dream to become the leader of the Invincibles, a powerful group that rules over the martial arts world with an iron fist. One day, Yong-Yeon is given the chance to join their ranks.

(Source: Toomics)

College life is a minefield! You know those times when you wish the ground would just open up and swallow you whole? Well, Mi-Seol sure does. She screwed up big time by ruining some random (hot) guy’s class schedule for the entire semester. Wracked with guilt, she hopes and prays she’ll never have to face him again… But the cruel hand of fate has other ideas! 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

During his high school days Sung-Hyun was confirmed as an Omega, and his relationship with four alphas who were his friends was cut off. He thought that they would never meet each other again, but he found himself reunited with them again one day. 

That fateful day, Sung-Hyun was surrounded by the four Alpha's and no matter how many inhibitors he took, he went into heat...

(Source: Lezhin, translated) 

*Note: Chapter count includes two extras.*

As the earth reaches its end due to environmental pollution, it wakes their ancient sleeping guardians to exterminate all mankind. A slum-born robot pilot Kay leads a war against these guardians, for the survival of humanity.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Shelly’s dream was to become an announcer, but who knew there was more to the job than just being on screen?!

(Source: Toomics)

Yeon is a competent, popular medical officer at East Seven Center, a defense facility located on the outskirts of the city with a big secret.
When Woo Tae-ha, the youngest Lieutenant General in history, comes to the Center, Yeon finds him familiar although he cannot quite grasp why.
Yeon begins to remember his past with Woo although Woo does not seem to remember anything. With a mystery in their hands, Yeon and Woo find themselves attracted to each other.

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

*Note: Includes 8 extra chapters*

My wife lost her sight due to an accident. Was surviving actually better or worse for her? Living with the sister-in-law is harder than I thought. 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jinwoo Kim, a university student with severe social anxiety, returns to school, determined to make new friends and overcome his conditions. But when his eyes meet Han Choi, the handsome and popular underclassman, he gags and runs out. Humiliated, Han vows to make Jinwoo fall for him. A seductive race between an introvert and prince charming... Who will be the winner? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 6 extra chapters.*

A conspiracy led by a selected few, freed from the hands of death after being infected by the vampire syndrome. After successfully establishing their world secretly, they became the most powerful entities by having control not only of the police but also of politics and the media. People who knew of their existence called them “The Afters”. Meanwhile, Tae-Su Dan, who had lost everything due to them, forms a strong team for his revenge. Having established his team, Tae-Su heads to “Red table”, a prison camp for bloodbags, to rescue Dam Yi, the bloodbag with the best blood on Earth. How will Tae-Su Dan carry out his revenge? And will he and his friends succeed?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

 *Note: Includes a prologue*

*"How about a game with me?"* 

The billiard club in front of the college is always full of men. The secret? The sexy, seductive women who works there! Come play a game with the hottest girls in town!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Having recently moved to Seoul, innocent young man Sang-Ho Kim gets a job at a Chinese restaurant. His day begins with a whirlwind of deliveries and ends with passionate sex. Which woman will Sang-Ho pick?

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Woo-Jung was a child star who had to give up his dreams because of some malicious rumors. Carrying that trauma with him, he’s now just a normal high school student. When some bullies confront Woo-Jung on the first day of school, a majestic figure, like a hero from a video game, magically comes to Woo-Jung’s rescue... 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes an epilogue and seven side story chapters. The side stories are rated R19.*

Office worker Mi-Rae just wants a happy life with her boyfriend. But how long can her dream last?

(Source: Toomics, edited)

A men's clinic in the neighborhood is always filled with male patients. Is there something different about this clinic?

(Source: Toomics)

The only joy in Viss’ life, while working as a delivery man for the Chinese restaurant Miss Lan China, is when once every three days he gets violently involved with the mysterious handsome man Graven. One day, while musing why Graven would lust after his plain self, Viss, who went to a motel after getting a call from Graven, received the blood-stained body of a man as a gift. The reeking smell of blood caused him to faint, and when he woke up, Graven confessed something shocking to the confused Viss. 

*“Do you remember...the kid you saw at the apple farm ten years ago?”*

When the town of Night relocates all of the townspeople to build a temple for its goddess Obscurity, 12-year-old Mane and 9-year-old Nox start a new life in the neighboring town of Morning. Trouble awaits them when Nox vanishes as if by magic, and Mane turns to Morning’s goddess Lumiere for help. Told that he must vanquish Obscurity to save his kidnapped sibling, Mane is given the body of a grown man and sent on a perilous journey. Will Mane be able to save his sibling in a world where nothing is as it seems? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After Sebastian and Mia's house burns down, they move in with Carter and Emma. But things start to get heated. 

(Source: Toomics)

A secret office romance between the son of the CEO of a huge conglomerate and his newbie secretary slash perpetual liar! Yeonju gave up her career in order to chase after love, but only found herself left with scars and pain…After getting a position at a huge company as a secretary, she finds herself face-to-face with her new boss, Jaehyun, who also happens to be a former classmate of Yeonju’s! Jaehyun’s serious good looks and short temper earned him the nickname among his employees, “the S.H.B.”, or the “super, handsome bastard”. 

After a series of humiliating situations, Jaehyun admits that he no longer just wants to be friends, and would rather date. Yeonju, who had her mind set on never dating ever again, finds herself interested despite how hard she tries not to fall for him! 

(Source: NetComics)

*"Had he been a hero in his past life or something...?"*

*"That's right. I once rescued this nation from destruction."*

When Ja-In is kidnapped due to his family's massive debt, Un-Jo happens to walk by and save him from his kidnappers. From that day onwards, Ja-In's life is never the same...

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Hye-Min Lee is your typical high school student, complete with a pet cat and an annoying older brother. But when the shapeshifting villainess Nero unleashes a cat the size of an apartment building to terrorize Hye-Min’s hometown, Hye-Min comes into possession of a magical watch and finds her true calling: she must join the fight against feline foes and become a Meow Ranger.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Mark is a novelist who only gets inspirations through his neighbors.One day, he welcomes a cheeky unexpected guest to his house.

(Source: Toomics)

Can Yuli save humanity?! 

Eaters — intelligent creatures from outer space that prey on Earthlings. Problem is, even though they look like humans, no one knows how to talk with them! Enter Yuli, the only known human to date who can communicate with the Eaters. Can Yuli save the world AND her love life? 

(Source: Manta)

“Chimeras” are people that have been infused with animal DNA in order to give them superpowers and abilities, however society doesn’t favor them so they live in fear and rejection. Our main character, code name “01”, works as a mercenary who happens upon an old acquaintance. He’s then given a job to protect and transport Enoch, a girl who is sought out to be the perfect “material”, to the borders of Canada.

There’s an old rumor about the Schravant’s mansion. That a dark devil will, one day, come to take away the beautiful master of the house. It seems to be nothing more than fanciful thinking, but how does that explain the change that Mihael brings when he barges into the Schravant brother’s lives? The devil will find what Evan and Victor Schravant desire, even if they desperately try to suppress those urges. They say the world’s a stage—what play will these dark souls enact?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ran is the young empress of the North Empire. In order to protect her empire, she must assassinate the Orhan, the new emperor of the West Empire. Ran plans to ensnare Orhan in a honey trap by guising a beautiful assassin as tribute of good will. It is revealed, however, that the emperor is not interested in any other woman but Ran herself. Rude and arrogant like a savage, the emperor dares to claim the heart of the noble empress. Left without a choice, Ran decides to hide her identity and sends herself as tribute to the emperor. Can the empress win the emperor's trust? Will the empress be able to assassinate the emperor?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

In the deepest depths of the mountains, there lies a small village where budding physicians learn how to help those in need. It is a place Cho-ah calls home, and he expects to spend the rest of his days there. However, everything changes when a mysterious, heavily wounded man appears out of nowhere. Cho-ah does his best to nurse the stranger back to health, despite the misgivings that his fellow students have about him. The man’s name is Mujin, and it soon becomes clear that the only person he trusts is Cho-ah. How will this handsome stranger change Cho-ah’s life? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

With the death of his grandfather, Jihoo stands to inherit his company—and a massive amount of wealth. There’s just one catch: he must spend a year with “the person he loves.” But for Jihoo, that’s complicated. Not only did that person, Eun-yul, leave him five years ago, but now she has a kid! Can Jihoo push through years of hard feelings and awkwardness to win her back? Is he really just doing it for the company?

(Source: Tapas)

A world where magic exists.
The famous wizards known as “red and blue eyes” are considered nothing more than a legend after being assassinated for their special abilities. In modern times, they appear as heroes in movies and soap operas and thus become wildly popular.
The newly elected minister of magic announces his plan to destroy the magic ball that caused a disaster. Heera, who has been hiding her identity as “red and blue eyes” her whole life, joins in the effort to break up the magic ball for her sick daughter. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

The four of us are friends, but do friends sleep with each other...?

(Source: Toomics)

You can become desperate when revenge is on your mind. Will Lily be able to use her desperation to succeed? 

(Source: Toomics)

He has a handsome face, sculpted body, as well as a friendly personality. The best Shine Muscat grape-like man who stands in front of Siho, who wants a perfect man, is Jaewon. As for the bitter sour grape-like man who’s around Siho, is Hanjun. Where will the whereabouts of the three men who are torn between God-given ideal types and an unforgettable ex end?

Eun-Ha and Eun-Sang are twins. Although their looks are identical, their personalities are the complete opposite. Due to their clashing differences, Eun-Ha can't stand his older twin brother. 

So far, Eun-Ha has never been on a date, let alone make friends, because of how scary he looks. When he decides a start fresh in college, he meets his ideal man, Han Yeo-Reum. But when he realizes his crush has been mistaking him for twin brother this whole time, he now has to come to a decision. Will he tell him the truth or continue pretending to be his brother? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

What do you think you're doing with that axe?! When the stag god, Cheongyeon, is rescued from a hunter by a woodsman named Mooksan, he knows Mooksan is just what he's missing up in heaven. But little does Cheongyeon know, Mooksan is no ordinary woodsman...

(Source: Manta)

Ivan is a guardian android, responsible for teaching the orphanage children everything they’ll need to thrive in the big, wide world. Rau has been in Ivan’s care for years now, but recently they’ve grown distant. What’s more, Rau’s graduation into adulthood has brought on physical changes, mood swings and uncontrollable urges. Desperate to rebuild bridges before Rau’s impending departure, Ivan offers to grant him a birthday wish. The problem is, Rau’s most ardent desire is to get lessons in sex. From Ivan. Kids these days sure grow up fast…

(Source: Lezhin)

Ever since she married rich hottie Seo Moon-hyuk, people began to call Jo Eunae the “Cinderella of the 21st Century.” But Eunae’s life is no fairy tale, and her marriage…well, it’s barely even real! Imagine still being a virgin after three years of marriage! Desperate to live the life she’s always wanted, Eunae asks for a divorce on the anniversary of their 1000th day of marriage. Except, suddenly her oh-so-sexy husband seems interested in her for the first time! He’s putting in more effort than ever before, but why now…?

(Source: Lezhin X)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

*"Let me help you masturbate."*

Min-Hyuk falls for his girlfriend's sister, who is a mature, sexy girl. One day, he ends up seeing her touching herself. He should've just ignored it, but he just couldn't resist the temptation...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

In the Sun Empire, only women can be the ruling monarch. In this world, Emperor Yuri, who doesn’t believe in love, struggles to stabilize her hold on the throne. Meanwhile, her treacherous husband aspires to become emperor himself. Seeing through his intent, Yuri decides to take in other consorts. While looking for candidates, she comes across former Prince Doha. He tells her that he believes in true love and that he doesn’t hate anyone. Intrigued, Yuri decides to invite him to the palace. What does she want? And will she be able to gain a firmer foothold on the throne? 

(Source, Tappytoon)

Unbeknownst to his classmates, Shin Eunchae was born with a golden spoon in his mouth. He eats only the finest foods, travels in the most extravagant fashion, and has access to things beyond his classmates’ wildest imagination. Kang Juwon, on the other hand, is a poor, aspiring actor with the determination to make it big. When Juwon saves Eunchae from dangerous situation with a sunbae, the two grow especially close. There’s only one problem- Juwon hates Chaebols! Eunchae’s elite background must remain a secret, but things get complicated when Eunchae wants to help Juwon achieve his dream to become an actor. How will Eunchae navigate this new, uncharted territory…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: My Fiancée Is a Vampire Hunter!
description:
Sometimes, all it takes is a little fall for you to see the world around you differently. 

When Louis is magically ensnared and driven off a cliff by Maxie, a ruthless vampire hunter, he wakes up only to realize that the woman who was determined to kill him a moment ago has replaced her memory with the impression that the two of them are engaged.

Louis must decide whether to tell her the truth and risk paying with his life, or end up marrying a notorious, cold-blooded killer whose old memories could return to her at any moment. A little white lie couldn’t hurt, right? Especially not when your life is on the line.

(Source: Lezhin US)

They say there is a thin line between love and hate… 

Prince Kaliyan takes over as the new Emperor at the end of a long and bloody war for the throne. After years of secretly fulfilling Kaliyan’s desires as his sword, Ian knows he is no longer needed and goes into hiding. Ian receives news of his brother Robin’s impending execution after years of silence, and rushes back to the palace. He is after his once-beloved Kaliyan, hell-bent on getting his revenge. Instead, out of their reunion erupts a steamy yet deadly imperial romance! 

(Source: Netcomics)

Min Sung and Ji An became brothers after their parents remarried. Eight years later, Min Sung, now twenty-six years old, works as a food stylist and his younger brother Ji An, now twenty-three years old, works as a model and is strangely obsessed with Min Sung. The two develop a mutual relationship to relieve each other’s heat and rut periods. At first, Min Sung thought his younger brother's persistent and obsessive behavior over him was nothing more than cute and whiny attachment. But when it begins to develop into a bigger problem, Min Sung does his best to distance himself from Ji An. They slowly drift apart, but as Min Sung’s buried past begins to unfold once more, their relationship slowly becomes catastrophic. 

(Source: Copin Comics)

*Note: The chapter count includes 2 extras.*

Yidun, a boy who suddenly fell from the sky can only remember two things: His name, and the fact that he will cease to exist if he doesn't find the 5 hidden treasures to defeat the demon king. With only 79 days left to find the treasures Yidun still cannot pass by people who are in need without lending a helping hand. Can he defeat the demon king in under 80 days and avoid his death?

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)

Sex is so important for a healthy relationship. So when both sides are dissatisfied, it's easy for hussies to sneak in and try to make things worse. Both husband and wife will have to make a choice...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

There’s a new man in town, and he’s unexpectedly about to go on a sneaky quest to barter, meet, and interact with the surrounding’s new townspeople.

(Source: Toomics)

Why does he look like my ex...? 

After a traumatic first love, Mi-Jeong is determined to put her past behind her and start fresh in college. But when she enters school, she meets an upperclassman with the exact same face as her first love! Will she be able to heal her past scars and learn to love again? 

(Source: Manta, edited)

This series is a collection consisting of several short stories, which includes short stories of BL (Boys' Love), GL (Girls' Love) and Straight Love. 

The collection includes:
1-3. **Naemyeongbuui Nan** (내명부의 난, The Court Lady) \[Gangajijoa\]
4-7. **Majimak Sowon** (마지막 소원, Last Wish) \[Kim Pol-Jjak\]
8-12. **Sagikkundeul** (사기꾼들, Fraudsters) \[Kang-Neuk\]
13-15. **Yeon Ri-Ji** (연리지, Lotus Ridge) \[Donggeurami\]
16-18. **Nae Sanyangkkuni Ireoke Gwiyeoul Ri Eopseo!** (내 사냥꾼이 이렇게 귀여울 리 없어!, My Hunter Can't Be This Cute!) \[Jaeng-Ko\]
19-25. **Banwolui Seonbi** (반월의 선비, The Crescent Scholar) \[Merin\]
26-28. **Ho-Dong Seolhwa** (호동설화, Tale of Hodong) \[San-Mi\]

When Kwon Yi-soo’s mom marries her long-term boyfriend, of course Yi-soo’s happy for her. But is it too much to ask that his new stepbrother not be his ex-fuckbuddy who is ALSO his boss, Han Gangjin? Yi-soo is desperate to stop him from revealing their relationship to their parents, but Gangjin doesn’t have the same qualms. He hadn’t been happy about Yi-soo breaking things off, after all. So Gangjin offers him a deal: they resume seeing each other in exchange for their parents’ blissful married life. But can that be all that Gangjin wants…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world of money, fame, and secrets, Sherry finds herself being the bride of a wealthy family... However, it's far from simple. 

(Source: Toomics)

After playing the worst match of his life, pro footballer Minhyuk ’s life comes to a tragic end in a car accident… Or so everyone thinks. He wakes up, alive and swell, in the body of Baek Chan—the heir to Baek Pharmaceuticals. Despite his best efforts to move on and live as Chan, the memories of his past life keep haunting Minhyuk and he ends up at his now-widowed wife’s door… Will Minhyuk tell Sooyeon who he is? And more importantly, will this new lease on life lead to an old lease on love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: The chapter count includes a prologue*

Hailey is beautiful and perfect. But... she has one little secret that nobody knows about.

(Source: Toomics)

Deacon is a former warrior who once enjoyed a life of fame and honor, that is to say, before he went completely bankrupt. While Deacon rummages around to look for work, he runs into Lagabi: his long-time wizard friend and his secret crush. Knowing Deacon's situation, Lagabi decides to hire Deacon to assist him in his research projects that involve "special" experiments. Deacon enthusiastically accepts the offer, but the next thing he knows, he's being toyed by some slimy demonic tentacles! Turns out that this research assistant job wasn't exactly what Deacon had expected it to be. Now Deacon finds himself trapped in a cycle of pleasure, and he's willing to let his secret desires loose... 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Gi-woo has always been a merciless go-getter. He was a top student in school, and now he’s playing all his cards right at work. He gets the ladies, too, of course, and though his marriage is loveless, you can’t tell from the outside. One day, he receives news that an old professor of his, a father figure, has passed away. Gi-woo rushes to the funeral and meets the beautiful widow and her gorgeous daughter for the first time in years. Soon enough, desires old and new begin to snowball beyond control… A new series from the creator of “Redemption Camp” and “The Seagull and the Hunter”!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.*

Time travel that messed everything up.
After discovering a mystery incense stick, Seol-A finds out that she can travel back in time by lighting the incense stick. With her new ability, Seol-A saves her mother and thinks she's finally found her happy ending. However, she realizes that her time-traveling ability comes with a price when she finds out that her first love I-Jun is now dating her best friend...

(Source: Manta, edited)

*Note: This work is inspired by the K-Drama "Nine: Nine Time Travels".*

Looks like Dae-Man’s made it. He’s secured a job at the most prestigious cram school in Gangnam: an academy full of the rich, the studious, and the incredibly sexy. With hot girls seducing him from all directions, he’s all set to enjoy himself, but… What should he do if their advances put his cushy job at risk?! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

An enormous fortune, a beautiful sprawling estate, and five adoring male maids... what more could a gal wish for? Yeon-Hwa Lee is living out every girl's fantasy when she suddenly inherits her grandfather's estate, including his five loyal servants. Bom and Yeong-Ho are so cute and adorable, Alexander is buff and sexy, while Won-Hu and Edward are elegant and cool. Their only desire is to service their mistress... and Yeon-Hwa simply can't resist. 

(Source: Tapas, edited) 

*Note: Includes a prologue and 11 extra chapters.*

Hyunwoo, Yiseul, Nayeon, and Jimin – the four once-inseparable friends coincidentally run into each other in college. The surprise reunion is riddled with confusion, as some members of the group are less than thrilled about the meeting. Everything from their looks to their personalities has changed, and Hyunwoo is soon faced with the ultimate question: “Is it okay to sleep with your friends?!”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Age doesn’t matter when it comes to love… or who you’re physically attracted to.

(Source: Toomics)

27-year-old virgin Eun Chae-Yi becomes an overnight sensation when a Hollywood star kisses her at an airport in front of hundreds of fans and cameras. And if that isn’t enough, the next night, a handsome prince of a mysterious country woos her into an unforgettable one-night-stand. But when both these strangers insist that she is their lover from a past life, Chae-Yi must figure out what are memories and what are dreams, what is fate and what is fraud.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He thought it was all over when he got stuck in a small town to study for his university exams. But the girls at the hair salon he found changed everything...*"What would you like today? Just ask!"*

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Are we really friends? Or are we something else? Seo-Hui and Eun-Ho have known one another for 15 years, and they've always been each other's top priority. Their relationship blurs the line between friends, family, soulmates, and lovers. But one day, it comes to a tipping point when Seo-Hui suddenly declares,

*"Eun-Ho, I can't do this anymore."*

(Source: Manta, edited)

Jae-Hyeon has always gotten everything that he wanted, but the housekeeper's son, Eun-Hae, was the one person that he desired above anything else. So when Jae-Hyeon heard that Eun-Hae's moving away, of course he's going to push him down the stairs. Eun-Hae loses his memory due to the accident, and Jae-Hyeon decides that he will never desire anything ever again. However, an unexpected reunion with Eun-Hae triggers Jae-Hyeon's desires to come rushing back... 

(Source: Lezhin US)

If a stranger invits you to witness his sex experiment, what would you do? What if you were someone who was having sex problems after 10 years of marriage? Will your brain win out, or your dick?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Jang Hada, a crop growth scientist, crash-lands in a famine-stricken world…where a priest named Pota mistakes him for their missing king. Declared the "Sun King," Hada is roped into saving the kingdom's failing crops while dodging awkwardly steamy lines and madcap encounters. With a little bit of sweat, potatoes, and some questionable chemistry—can they save the kingdom before it fries? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

Yu Yu was bullied during his school days for his obesity, but after years of hard work and exercise, he has become a famous beauty director sought by everyone. However, his issues with talking to women pose a problem when dealing with customers. Thus his boss assigns him and several other troublemakers a project in order to fix their problems. During this event, his old crush, Ain Joo, appears in front of him.

[Original Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/content/54310637)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.lalatoon.com/en/webtoon/episode/toon/7101), [French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/daf_0000436), [Thai](https://th.kakaowebtoon.com/content/%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%AA%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A2%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%89%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B1%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%9F%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%B2/176)

For Lee Kang, the captain of the swim team, life is a constant power struggle. And whether it's in sports, or in bed - he always wins. But when Junho from the baseball team accidentally witnesses him having sex with the TA, Kang finds his unyielding new opponent. Will Junho get destroyed just like the others, or will he remain standing with a defiant look in his eyes? 

(Source: Lezhin)

He has a condition he hides from everyone... He can't even last a minute in bed! After not being able to satisfy his girlfriend, he finds a famous doctor who is an expert in sex. But he didn't expect the beautiful, sexy doctor to just take his thing in her mouth for treatment!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Noah prides herself in having many “more-than-friendship-but-less-than-love” type friends, but out of them Ji-Hoon Park is especially distant. So in her attempt to get closer to him, she gets drunk but accidentally gets physically friendlier instead. What a disaster. But, what's this? But after a drunken hookup, what's this? I'm loving his great body!!

(Source: Copin Comics)

Jisue, a skilled wedding planner who specializes in weddings among the wealthy, thought she could handle anything that came her way. But she wasn’t ready to lose a $500,000 tiara… nor was she ready to start working for Wooseok, the new CEO of I-Hill Hotel. And she definitely isn’t ready to fulfill his absurd demand in return for the money he lends her. Will Jisue and this businessman strike a deal and part ways, or will things just get more complicated? 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.*

Shinwoo is fed up with people asking him if he’s going out with Juho. It doesn’t matter what others say or think; he has accepted that fact that Juno always has been - and always will be - nothing more than a good friend…even if Shinwoo wants them to be something more. Sure, he might have been crushing on Juno for no less than 10 years, but that doesn’t change the reality of the situation: Juho is simply not interested in men, and their friendship is more important than a little crush. However, a confession by Juho is about to shock Shinwoo to the core: his supposedly straight best friend has…a boyfriend?! But something seems more than just a bit off. Juho is always hanging out with Shinwoo instead of this “boyfriend” of his, and is seemingly hung up on his opinion of his new lover… Is this new turn of events setting Shinwoo up for failure, or could it be fate, setting Shinwoo up with the love of his life? 

(Source: Lezhin) 

*Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.*

The world changed one day. In the world of humans, the devils showed up. No one knows how creatures from different dimensions managed to appear in the human world. Cain was abandoned by his parents and raised by Guseul, the ace of Evil Hunter. During his mission, he met a little girl with blue hair, a mixed creature of a human and a beast.

(Source: DAYcomics)

What happens when a man meets three women who need money? 

(Source: Toomics)

There's a such moment in your life. All of a sudden, you happen to look the world through a pastel tone filter from a high-teen romance film, and the moment when the sunlight through leaves gets brighter. The moment when a blink of an eye clearly reflects one single person for a long time. 

In other words, this is a story about recognizing our first love and a process of telling the feeling.

Hae-Seo Han is an ordinary, hard-working office worker whose main concerns revolve around being overlooked for promotions, smug colleagues, and workplace stress. That is, until she finds herself intertwined in a prophecy that will determine the fate of a fantasy world! In the realm of the Beiston Empire, Hae-Seo is seen as the oracle who will determine the next successor to the throne and bring peace to the country. Hoping to win Hae-Seo’s favor and become the next emperor, the three charming yet eccentric princes of Beiston cross over into Hae-Seo’s world to begin their lives together as housemates!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Jinkyung is a young doctor who has her eye on a promotion. The only problem is, all the obstacles she has to get through to achieve her goal. There’s the hard-ass Dr. Kang, the young residents, Dr. Jo and Dr. Kim and of course, the one who holds her ultimate fate in his hands, old geezer Dr. Park. But one day, a mysterious figure sends Dr. Jinkyung a steamy video of herself. She can’t let this video get released to the public! And thus the game begins… Jinkyung must do as this shadowy figure says and play along in their twisted reality game if she wants to keep her reputation and career in tact. But just who is Lyly John…?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Min-Young - having graduated from an all-girls middle school, high school, and college and now working as a lingerie designer - knows zero-to-nothing about men and subsequently has never dated anyone. When the CEO of her company suggests setting her up on a blind date, she has no other choice but to say yes. She goes on the date only to be faced with an off-putting yet handsome guy, who ignores her for the majority of the time but then has the audacity to suggest seeing each other. Flabbergasted, she decides to leave and to never see him again... little did she know, she would meet him the next day as the photographer on her project at work. On the other hand, Dong-Hwa remembers meeting Min-Young ten years ago and can't help but smile at her spunk and confidence. Despite her rather lukewarm reaction, he's determined to play to win her heart. Let the games begin! 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

The journey to overcoming abuse.

Haram is running away from home for the third time. After struggling with life in a dormitory, she's decided to stay at a shelter for homeless adolescents. Haram is worried about living with others while managing her depression and trauma... but she's determined to find happiness.

(Source: Manta)

After breaking up with his first love, Sean discovers that there's no one else for him but her. But turns out one of his brothers felt the same way. 

(Source: Toomics)

With Earth’s future in jeopardy, the space colony run by UTS officials is paradise. Ace pilot Taeho’s a squadron leader for UTS, but after questioning their actions, he ends up on the scavenger crew of the Victory alongside rugged Tiger Park, sassy robot Updong, and fearless Captain Jang. They’re chasing dreams, working off debts, and pissing everyone off. Enter Dorothy… they take her in and now EVERYONE’S after them. Can they figure out this mess or is this a ticking time bomb about to explode? 

(Source: Tapas)

Beatriz is a duchess with a well-earned reputation for a deviant sex life. Well, she used to be a duchess. When she’s stabbed to death, she wakes up as Jae-young, an ordinary college student in modern times. With a whole new world at her disposal, Beatriz decides to enjoy herself. And there is so much to enjoy: modern technology, education she used to be barred from, and plenty of sex.
