As Jae-young, she’s going to conquer not only her new life, but also as many men and women as she wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Is It Okay to Get Wet?
description:
Nam-Joo works as a swimming instructor, and clients are rich, married women, who are lonely! So when they start asking him for some "extracurricular" lessons, there's no reason not to oblige!

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Born under the Star of Darkness, Princess Baekseon always knew she was fated for something big, but it’s only after she disguises herself as a boy and leaves the safety of the palace that she begins to see just how big. Malicious old hags, cheerful goblins, lovesick witches, and the promise of a mysterious soulmate with red and blue eyes are just the beginning: ultimately, what hangs in the balance is the fate of the world itself. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

*"It's okay if you try it... I promise it'll taste good..."*

She had kept her sexual desires hidden, not wanting to disappoint the one she loved. But the more her husband cherished her, the harder it became to suppress her instincts. And when her pent-up lust finally exploded, it wasn't directed at her husband, but at his secretary.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Make a wish and destiny will make sure to interfere. Eun-Deok is a (wannabe) normal high school freshman. But alas, he is too tall and built for his own convenience -- chased by every varsity team wooing him since Day 1, he runs and runs and then ends up in a basketball court, a space where his childhood trauma and frustration still remain. Mistaken as a rumored super-rookie, our hero reluctantly picks up the ball. But, this time, it looks like there is something to help him carry on.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

display_title: The Legend of the Fitting Room Watchman
description:
Some doors should stay closed. 

Jaeho is a genius but receives little recognition. He opens a clothing store, unaware that the building he rents is hiding a secret portal to another world! One day a man emerges, speaking in tongues. How does he know Jaeho’s name? Where is he from? Most importantly, what does he want with Jaeho? 

(Source: Manta)

An aspiring cartoonist decides to become an adult cartoonist's assistant... but little did he know he'd fall in love with his teacher's wife.

(Source: Toomics)

Sa-Rang Jin is one of the most famous actresses in South Korea, and she has it all—talent, good looks, and a loving fiancé... or not! One week before their wedding, her groom-to-be ghosts her. She desperately searches everywhere for In-Ha, only to discover he’s lied to her throughout their entire relationship. To her dismay, his secret triggers her own personal misfortunes with shamanism. Heartbroken and traumatized by her past, will she be able to accept him for who he is? 

(Source: Tapas)

Taking a break from love.

When Dan-Hui's boyfriend Jeong-Hu tells her he wants to spend some time apart, she decides to use this chance to enjoy her freedom. But after running into her former crush, Tae-Yong, she begins to wonder what she really wants out of life.

(Source: Manta, edited)

See what happens behind closed doors of this secretive town.

(Source: Toomics)

Moon Da-Mi’ll do anything to escape the clutches of Mr. Sohn, the evil CEO who’s out to get her guts—literally. Her rare blood type makes her an invaluable resource to the old man, but when his obsession with her results in a family tragedy, Da-Mi needs to find a way to step up her survival game. She seeks help from an unlikely source: the handsome but haughty Kang Taesung, owner of Taekyung Financial. Impressed by her bravery, Mr. Kang agrees to protect Da-Mi's body from Mr. Sohn’s schemes…but who will protect Da-Mi from Mr. Kang? Caught up in the wild wars of the rich and powerful, will Da-Mi be able to change the demons of her past into the blessings of her future? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The World Ends at the Jump
description:
*"We are no different from gods."* 

Hyunhee starts a new job as a server developer at a budding game company. As she digs deeper into a mysterious bug where if a player makes the character jump 65,536 times, the server shuts down, what shocking truths will she uncover? It's just a game... right? 

(Source: Manta)

*The fate of an unfaithful husband.*

Mr. Kim has lived alone ever since his wife mysteriously fell off a cliff. Her body was never found, and Mr. Kim believes that she is still out there. On a dark, pouring day, Mr. Kim revisits the site of her presumed death. On his search for her, he comes across an old man that creates scarecrows for "souls"... 

(Source: Manta)

Solyi Jin, a recently turned Omega, was given the job to find proof of a famous actor's scandal. This famous Alpha actor, Kieun Baek, unfortunately caught Solyi Jin and gave him proper punishment.
Kieun Baek grows closer with Solyi Jin, he soon finds out somebody was plotting against him... 

(Source: INKR)

Not even a year into high school, Poli Na has already had enough. Everything seems so pointless, and her own life is no exception. That is, until a mysterious, transparent dragon appears and destroys the planet in a fit of rage. As the only person who can see this crystal-clear dragon, Poli is chosen to travel back in time to another world so that she can save Earth and this alternate world from being destroyed. The fate of two worlds hangs on Poli’s efforts to win over Israhi, the invisible dragon, and turn him toward the light. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Seo Jeong-In, the second son of a wealthy judge's family, fails to get into the university his father wants, unlike his older brother. Consequently, he ends up in a dormitory at a rural cram school catering to upper-class students. Having been aware of his sexual identity from an early age, Jeong-In has been enjoying a free-spirited and indulgent gay lifestyle. However, things turn for the worse when his dorm roommate, Seung-Hyun, captures footage of Jeong-In in a sticky situation with his friend Han Min-Woo using a hidden camera installed in their room... 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes five side story chapters.*

Saetbyeol had a lot on his plate: he's an omega who hates alphas, his mom is constantly causing trouble, and his high school boyfriend is a jerk. Naturally, he ran off and hid himself after graduation to live a new life away from these problems. But one day, he runs into Hyeontae, a friend from his past that he's been running from for so long. It shouldn't be a big problem though, since Hyeontae's a beta who just wants to be a good friend...or is he? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Knee deep in debt, I might just believe this crazy man claiming to be a dragon...

(Source: Lalatoon)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

Jo Ajin, a sophomore studying economics, gets excited whenever he hears Sahyuk's voice. Despite his efforts to avoid Sahyuk at all costs, they end up working together on a group project. To Ajin’s surprise, Sahyuk confesses his feelings for Ajin in a sweet, melodic tone. What's the secret behind Sahyuk's captivating voice?

(Source: Lezhin)

A new life unfolds when he moves to the countryside after getting fired from his company. There he learns the real definition of taboo.

(Source: Toomics)

How long is too long to spend in space? When astronaut Webber Jones returns to Earth after a 20 year mission, he brings with him an interesting problem. Due to spending the last two decades with nothing but an AI robot dog as company, he’s lost the ability to tell the difference between dogs and people. Of course, excitable psychiatrist Benjamin rogers isn’t expecting this case to be easy, but he encounters an unexpected problem in the fact that the handsome, mature Webber is exactly his type! The things is, it’s hard to treat a man who thinks of you as nothing more than his four-legged friend, and soon Benjamin realizes he may have bitten off more than he can chew… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Resurrecting someone is never easy.*

Tae-Su, K, and I have been best friends since elementary school but one day, K stops coming to school. Tae-Su and I visit K but see him die of illness before their very eyes. K's mom tells them that to resurrect K, she has to get the right "ingredients"... 

(Source: Manta)

I need to focus on work, but I keep getting distracted by my coworkers!

(Source: Toomics)

From the outside, Dr. Cha Hanjoo has the perfect life. He’s handsome, loaded, and the head of a famous dermatology clinic in Seoul’s richest neighborhood. If that wasn’t enough, he also has the perfect wife, Yeri. But beneath the veneer, cracks are beginning to form. Unable to satisfy Yeri’s sexual cravings, Hanjoo goes to inhuman lengths to please her. Who will get hurt in the process? Wounds heal, but the scar remains. And perfection never lasts forever. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes 8 side stories.*

Loire is a kingdom where the rumor that touching a rose will curse you runs rampant… 

Ines, the daughter of a merchant, works hard at trimming the roses in her village. She is the only one who has never feared the curse of the rose. But, Ines has a secret. 

She gets locked up in the cellar of her house whenever there is a new moon. One day, after a problem arises with the merchant ship, her father is forced to leave the house despite the coming of the new moon. Ines wakes up in an unfamiliar palace, having no idea where she is. In this place, she runs into a suspicious wizard, but thanks to the black rose, a fairytale romance between the princess and a wizard unfolds! 

(Source: Netcomics)

Your biggest fan since day one.

Hanul has always been Sanso's biggest supporter. But as Sanso gets closer to his dream of becoming a singer, they begin to drift apart. Four years later, Hanul has a boyfriend, and Sanso is in a popular idol group. Somehow, fate brings them together again. Will they share how they really feel this time?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 6 extras.*

As the White Dragon succumbs to the warrior’s blade, it makes a final wish: to exact its revenge on the warrior, whom it had begun to consider its only friend. When the White Dragon next opens its eyes, it’s to find out that it’s been reborn...as a child. Not any child, but the warrior’s only daughter! The White Dragon, now known as Mir, has to adjust to being doted on daily until a certain incident breaks her newfound peace. Whisked away from her family, Mir is ordered to become the wife of a tyrant, but she won’t follow orders without a fight. After all, Mir may have the body of a weak and feeble human, but she’s still the strongest of all dragons at heart.The world's strongest white dragon... becomes the tyrant's wife? 

(Source: Lezhin)

The boy-band-turned-writer, Lin, receives an offer to have his book turned into a film from Yeon Seoho, a former fellow band member. Lin declines at first but decides to leave it to a bet. If Seoho can satisfy him on 5 dates, then he'd give them permission. And so, a business arrangement begins between the two with the bet depending on Seoho's performance. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Sex Complex - Body Complex CG Toon
description:
A sexy new spin-off of *Body Complex*!! Enjoy this steamy compilation of the mature scenes from the original series, now made even more intimate. Jae-Hyun is a piano prodigy picked up by Kang Min-Woo, a world-renowned classical music professor. Outside of the classroom, they are secretly lovers, but Seo-Jin's surprise appearance soon changes everything...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Behind the powerful Cho family, a love story of the two Cho brothers fighting over one girl. Who will end up with her and what other secrets?

(Source: Toomics)

Ha-yoon’s freshman year of college isn’t particularly noteworthy. She became a fashion design major because it was a good fit for her GPA, she has no friends except the incredibly popular and gorgeous Soo-ah, and she has a crush on handsome upperclassman Jihoon. She’s content with her life as it is, but everything changes with a single post online. Now, a whole world of greed and fame built on social media awaits her, and Ha-Yoon is determined to find her place within it. Will Ha-Yoon find love and success in the cutthroat society of influencers? Like, comment, and follow to find out! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

As far as Cha Dain’s concerned, orgasms are an urban myth. After yet another boyfriend accuses her of being terrible in bed, she and her friends find comfort in the arms of some handsome hosts at a karaoke bar. But Dain gets more than her money’s worth with one host, Han-hae, and their electric night of sex proves to be the answer to all her prayers. Their chemistry is undeniable, and after that night, fate has them running into each other around every corner. But constant miscommunications and reminders of where they first met make it surprisingly difficult for them to truly commit to this relationship. Can these lovers figure out how to put aside their egos and embrace something completely new?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The story of a young professor's infidelity with one of his students while his wife is in a coma.

(Source: Toomics)

Won-yeong’s feeling the pressure of family life. Newly unemployed and with a wife and three kids to support, the bills keep stacking up. What’s worse, he hasn’t gotten laid in over a year… Talk about stress! Nevertheless, as the sole breadwinner, he resolves to buck up his ideas and earn some cash however he can. When you’re handsome, bright and eager to please, work should just fall in your lap, right?! Luckily for Won-yeong, it isn’t long before an old acquaintance reappears and makes an offer he can’t refuse. Time to put that talent to good use... and relieve some of that pent-up “stress” as well! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

The new boy group sensation “Poison” is out to conquer the K-Pop scene with their buff bodies and sexy charm. With a successful debut and thousands of eager fans, everything seems to be going well…or is it? As the group’s prim and proper leader, Sihyun should be dreaming of chart domination. But instead, his dreams are filled with fantasies about his groupmate, the sullen and mysterious Seong-eun. As the two spend more and more time together, they get caught up in a whirlwind of muddled passion and sweaty tension, both on and off the stage. Will they manage to keep things together? And will those dreams be fulfilled? 

(Source: Lezhin) 

*Chapter count includes three special episodes and a prologue*

Young, successful, ambitious. The young CEO was born to conquer. After his untimely death, he wakes up in an alternate world as the eldest daughter of Count Hall McGrewd. "I may be in a damsel's body, but you won't find me in any distress!" Follow the newly reborn Farrell Hall McGrewd as she begins to take over in the other world of nobles and magic.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Dwarfism in a zombie apocalypse.

During a zombie apocalypse, five survivors have taken refuge inside an old building. Food is delivered to the rooftop, but the only way up is through a chute too small for the average adult. Seongguk's dwarfism makes him the only candidate, but when he faces backlash, dark ideas begin to stir… 

(Source: Manta)

Honor. Glory. Justice. These are what martial artists fight for. Not Gumho Go, the second brother of the Baekdu Wind Sword Sect and the biggest slacker the martial arts world has ever seen. Spending more time sleeping than training, he’s perfectly happy being seen as a fool by his master and fellow disciples. But when the first brother is killed by a mysterious assailant, Gumho is forced to take his place as the eldest brother. As new enemies emerge to threaten the sect, Gumho is going to have to step up to become its unlikeliest protector! 

(Source: Tapas)

*"It takes more to satisfy me."*

Dayoung has the looks, the talent, and the wealth to back everything up, but she desires only one thing - having her friend Jae-seung watch her as she embarks on her risque digressions. Whether it's in the library, on the school grounds, or at home, Dayoung calls Jae-seung whenever the mood strikes her. But how does Jae-seung feel about all this? Behind the thrill and the facade are the haunting traces of his past, ever so lasting as a burn.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A GL short story collection. Women from different walks of life realize what's missing in their lives through chance encounters or unexpected realization of ties with kindred spirits at crossroads in life, or a period of self reflection. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Na-Ye's life is turned upside down when she kisses her collegue's boyfriend. She starts to hear malicious voices that no one else can. Where will these voices lead her? 

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Anna Howard has been waiting 10 years for the opportunity to become a professor at a university.

(Source: Toomics)

On the day of my father's funeral... I saw that bastard having sex with my mother. Years passed since then, and I found him with two beautiful women by his side...

*"I'm glad that you have so much for me to take!"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

Lany's caught up by the sins of her father's shortcomings. Can she escape her fate and survive in her new dire surroundings?

(Source: Toomics)

Welcome to Screengrab, the ultimate app for succubi to extract essence from all kinds of men! Capturing and breaking in a man has never been easier, and the view has never been this good. Take a front row seat to watch loner succubus Sola conquer a whole collection of men as she delves into their deepest, darkest desires in this steamy comic from the creator of *"S Flower"*. 

(Source: Lezhin)

Devout and gentle-hearted, Agatho firmly believes in the power of piety. When he met Noah six years ago, he instantly felt that leading the quiet boy towards religion would do him the world of good. His instincts were right—now, Noah has become an invaluable member of the church. While Agatho is proud of how Noah has changed, sometimes he does feel uncomfortable with the amount of trust the boy showers upon him. After all, the line between blind trust and dogged obsession is very, very thin...

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Who needs actors when you have AI?

Do-Yong was a child star when he was six. But now at the age of 20, he's just another unknown theater actor. Then a big-shot production company comes to him with an offer: "We're just going to borrow your name and your face. CGI will do the rest." After that, Do-Yong's life begins to change...

(Source: Manta)

Sam instructs them to stay at his friend's until he comes back. Their life at Sean's house, but is it all rainbows and butterflies?

(Source: Toomics)

After getting strong-armed by a temple elder, Kang Heon is stuck taking charge of The Grand Catalogue: a record of all male...members of the continent. Things only get worse when a single blunder involving Eihelen Eijin, a newcomer from the Western Continent, sends everything spinning off-course. Forced to cover up the accident and guard their respective secrets, the two join forces to complete the catalogue, stumbling into revelations about themselves (and countless men!) that neither was prepared for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.*

One kiss is all it takes.

“Have you kissed someone yet?” Yoona is constantly pestered by her parents to hurry up and kiss a boy. Why? Because students who don’t kiss someone before they turn 17 go crazy every time it rains! Yoona doesn’t want to wind up like the others at her school. Will she find someone to kiss in time?

(Source: Manta)

Jealousy Provokers is a popular channel run by Yu-Min Sun and Geon-Woo Ma. Clients reach out when they need help figuring out their crushes' feelings, and Yu-Min or Geon-Woo play the part of a potential love interest to gauge whether the feelings are mutual. Woo-Ri Goh's a huge fan of the show, so when she lands a job as the new manager, she couldn't be happier! But she soon realizes that seeing someone on screen is a lot different than knowing them in real life...

(Source: Tapas)

 *Note: Includes three side stories and one epilogue chapter.*

Returning university student Yun Se-Jun meets a man who looks like Seong-Jae, his childhood crush, but is disappointed to find out it's not him. Later at a drinking party, Se-Jun overhears that the man is actually school idol Jin Do-Won, who has excellent grades, appearance, and personality. Do-won takes the now-inebriated Se-Jun to his house and sleeps with him. The next day he makes a suspicious proposal to Se-Jun. Let's have a love rehearsal!

Se-Jun is shocked, thinking Do-Won is a madman, and is on his way out of the house, when he accidentally steps on an expensive watch that fell on the floor and breaks it...?!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

I'm gonna become the madam!
Failed college entrance exams leave Heera feeling hopeless. That is, until she submits her "appeal" to a theater troupe at a folk village, catching the attention of the troupe's leader and changing her path forever. Now, Heera strives not to go to college, but to become the troupe's madam! 

(Source: Manta)

After my family moved to Australia, I decided to move into a house with four women...

(Source: Toomics)

I got married as I dreamed of a happy life I see in fairy tales. But is this what all marriages are like?! 

(Source: Toomics)

I moved to the city for college, and who's there to welcome me? My pretty childhood friends!

(Source: Toomics)

Heewoon Kim dreams of a hot and steamy night with childhood friend and his long-time crush, Sunwoo Ahn, but lacks the courage to speak up and so devotes his time writing erotica instead. Coming from a wealthy family, Heewoon also has grand aspirations to sell his work off to Hollywood someday and he'll confess his love when that happens!

When one day, Heewoon witnesses Sunwoo, too busy to hang out, walking down the street with an unfamiliar girl and realizes his first crush is coming to an end. Heewoon falls asleep crying but wakes up in a dream world. And somehow he keeps ending up with Sunwoo...?

My erotica is becoming reality! Who knows?! I'll enjoy it!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Private lessons with a beautiful teacher... Is this a dream come true?! 

(Source: Toomics)

To the outside world, Ji-Hun and Seon-Jae seem like ordinary classmates, but there is something unspoken binding them that no one else can see. Ji-Hun follows Seon-Jae’s every word without question, as if under some quiet, unbreakable command. Watching from the sidelines is Ki-Wung, who grows increasingly disturbed by the dynamic and tries to pull Ji-Hun out of Seon-Jae’s shadow. As the line between control and devotion begins to blur, Ji-Hun must decide whether he can truly break free from Seon-Jae’s grip or if he has already surrendered to it completely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 12 side story chapters.*

Being a croquis model isn't a thing for everyone. But me? They say I'm pretty talented...

(Source: Toomics)

"Ina Yoo, an average girl from earth gets summoned to a fantasy world called Elysion where only males with magical powers exist and. Elysion summons females from other worlds and the men of Elysion treat the women with the utmost respect and try to charm the women to be selected as their husbands and mating partners. When the men of Elysion mate with the women, mana from the men are passed on to the women, and depending on the mana capacity of the person, the women can use this mana as their own power. 

Ina is courted by many men of the top hierarchy of Elysion population and her choice of husband affects her political powers in Elysion as well as magical powers. Ina is naturally able to receive much mana from the men, which is a great point of attraction for men, especially in positions of social power and influence. 

As Ina rises in social-political status with her increasing magical powers, a rival, Roxanne, appears and tries to overthrow Ina's influence in Elysion by creating riots. Ina now has to calm the riots but can she do so through her husbands and boyfriends...?" 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Lee Yoo, an ordinary aspiring actor, abandons his stable civil service job to chase his dreams. After enduring a series of crushing failures, he finds himself at the brink of giving up. Just then, a popular vlogger offers him a lucrative acting gig with a catch: Yoo must pretend to be his boyfriend. What begins as a simple business arrangement soon blurs the lines between fantasy and reality, leaving both men questioning what is genuine as their on-screen romance starts to feel all too real.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I was Eun-Ho Sun’s biggest fan… And I never should’ve let her meet my boyfriend. I thanked my lucky stars when this mysterious author granted me the only interview she’d ever given in her illustrious career. She shared intense, off-the-record secrets with me. I even thought we could be friends. At first, it seemed like an invitation to her home would solidify our friendship, but she wound up in bed with my boyfriend. Will the woman I once idolized actually steal away the love of my life?!

(Source: Tapas)

Genius artist Si-Uk was always lonely—friends envied him and adults tried to take advantage of him. If there was even one person who understood and hugged him, Si-Uk was ready to give them everything. And, eventually, Si-Uk met two men who understood him: Ryu Sin-U, a perfect man who seems to have never felt lonely; and Song Ji-Sin, who has tried harder than anyone else to avoid being lonely. The two men engage in a war of nerves to take over Si-Uk's heart, but the most dangerous man among the three is Lee Si-Uk...? 

(Source: Lezhin, translated) 

*Note: Chapter count includes two extras.*

While haunting her usual subway car one day, lonely ghost Park Ja-Eon receives a chance from a deity to redo one year of her life and earn a spot in eternal paradise. With the aid of a grumpy divine guardian and a newfound ability to see ghosts, Ja-Eon restarts her senior year of high school. As the unlikely duo ends up helping spirits and humans alike, they begin to reflect on their own relationships and regrets. But with the clock ticking on Ja-Eon’s second shot, is there time to set it right? 

(Source: Tapas, edited) 

*Note: Winner of the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Grand Prize at the 2019 Korea Contents Award. This work was first serialized on Dillyhub in 2018. Munhakdongne has been publishing it since 2020.*

I just lost my son, but his bride-to-be, my almost daughter-in-law is still living with me. What should I do?

(Source: Toomics)

Danny's mother who lived a miserable life passed away in an accident. Danny is now left with his wealthy sex addict of a dad.

(Source: Toomics)

Antlers in the office?  
As a carrier of the “Minotaur Syndrome,” Noon has the antlers and head of an animal. He finally manages to land a job, only to find his new office covered in foliage and the other employees with the same condition as him! Will he be able to make it through this new chapter in life in one piece?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55108820), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5509521), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/2404002173), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/ppulppul), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000047429), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=0zsa), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H040236716), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H040236716), [Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/episode/5395) 

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://manta.net/en/series/horns-horns-everywhere?seriesId=1458), [Japanese](https://www.amazon.co.jp/-/en/dp/B0C2PG7RMW/)

By anyone’s standards, Minhyeok is a good egg: he’s a reliable coworker, a faithful fiancé… a real stand up guy! The future looks rosy until one day he’s unceremoniously dumped by his future wife. As his dreams of domestic bliss go up in flames, Minhyeok goes off the rails. Strange thing is, his new devil-may-care attitude goes down extremely well with the ladies. And there are plenty of stunners around him who have been biding their time, waiting to pounce. Soon enough, Minhyeok learns that when the chips are down, you gotta rise to the occasion!

(Source: Lezhin US)

A wealthy man hires a maid to take care of his son who is currently in a coma. Something happens that night and soon, she is asked to leave the house. What could have possibly gone wrong?

(Source: Toomics)

Is he really the guy who weighed over 100 kilos? Kim Jin-Su returned to school and he’s back to get revenge on his bullies. 

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Doesn’t it just suck when a guy you dumped comes back as a prize?

(Source: Toomics)

A flock of women is getting pulled into this new divorcé's life. Is there a magnetic pull that's at work? Or is Joey's ex-wife jinxing him?

(Source: Toomics)

Daniel Winter, the werewolf, is on the run. The very person he's running away from is his past lover, Ian Summers, the dragon. Unconvinced by Daniel's disappearance, right after his proposal, Ian has made a vow to reclaim Danny's love once again, no matter what it takes. 

(Source: Pocket Comics) 

*Chapter count includes a prologue*

I never asked for a sister-in-law. My mind is saying no, but my body just can't resist!

(Source: Toomics)

*Help! An incubus that died a virgin has possessed me!*

Exorcist Palmoon Han gets a call from a man in distress. His new client, Dun-gab, has a few options to free himself from the demon, but none of them seem adequate. To help his client, Palmoon makes Dun-gab an offer he can't turn down. How will this offer help Dun-gab gain freedom from the incubus?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

 *Note: Chapter count includes 9 side story chapters.*

Taking orders from his boss, Namsoo goes to Baek-ho’s Gang in order to take care of some business. But little did he know that Baek-ho’s Gang’s namesake and leader would take a particular liking to Namsoo and capture him all for his own. Now Namsoo just desperately wants to escape but how will he break free from this insatiable lust…? 

(Soure: Lezhin)

Fresh out of college, Jiha Lim is basking in riches as a successful BL doujinshi artist of the megahit webtoon "Hot-Blooded Academy" by Art Kang. One day, Jiha snatches up a once-in-a-blue-moon opportunity to work for Art as his prized assistant. Little did he know he would fall for Art's blinding good looks at first sight. And thus begins Jiha's diabolically intricate plans to win him over... and also get him to play for the other team!

(Source: NETCOMICS)

Just before her passing, Seul-Gi's grandmother hands her a mysterious note. On it is an address where her grandmother claims to have hidden a secret inheritance. But when Seul-Gi visits the location, she finds that a stranger is already living there!

Will Seul-Gi be able to become the heiress she was meant to be?

(Source: Manta)

Jackson crushes deeply after Sadie, and Sadie has plans of her own to flunk through college. But not everything will go down smoothly...

(Source: Toomics)

Jaesung and his father were living alone, barely making ends meet in a tiny apartment when they get the terrible news from Japan that Jaesung’s older brother died. According to Jaesung’s incredibly sexy Japanese sister-in-law, it was his brother’s final wish for her and her sister to move to Korea and live with their family. The girls move in and, while mildly uncomfortable, Jaesung is putting up with it. But one night he comes home late from work and hears strange moaning sounds coming from his father’s bedroom. After peaking in, he finds his father and his sister-in-law having sex! At first, he’s extremely disgusted, but Jaesung can’t get the thought of his sister-in-law’s naked body out of his mind. If only his sister-in-law would let him get a taste as well… after all, his brother’s gone and he’s much younger and fitter than his father.

(Source: Lezhin X)

Ryan has a new stepmom. She's beautiful, smart and his age. What will happen when she decides to play with him? 

(Source: Toomics)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Taekwon High is no ordinary high school. For starters, the chairman is the legendary hero, Hoon Kim! But what will happen to this school after a strange transfer student joins, claiming to bring down the whole school? 

(Source: Toomics)

Being in debt is scary… How you recover is up to how desperate you are.

(Source: Toomics)

Hera is a dom who’s always looking for something “new.” It’s not until she gets introduced to Club Oasis that she finally finds her heaven on Earth: a BDSM club where anyone can make their wildest fantasies come true. This is a place where Hera can finally experience pleasure beyond what she’s ever imagined. But is she ready to go far beyond her comfort zone?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

A sudden guest in the middle of the night turns out to be my neighbor?! And a secret deal offered from my old landlord!

(Source: Toomics)

Larry is a comic senile old man, tending to his daily life. He needs plenty of help, but where could he possibly find it?

(Source: Toomics)

I want to be just like you. 

Ga-Bi miserably works a low-paying job at a nail salon. When Jin-Ju, an Instagram influencer who seems to have it all, visits the salon, Ga-Bi decides she wants to live her life. As Ga-Bi begins a double life of pretending to be just like Jin-Ju, their lives become more intertwined. What secrets of the Instagram celebrity will Ga-Bi uncover? 

(Source: Manta, edited)

Ga-Yun is a huge social media star. Offline, she garners as much attention, if not more.

(Source: Toomics)

An inexperienced author and a girl pair up to brainstorm ideas for a novel. What will the novel be about?

(Source: Toomics)

'Choi Hwan' is a promising young pianist both at home and abroad. However, in reality, he is just a 15-year-old boy confused by the identity his mother created for him. 

One day before a competition, Choi Hwan's improvisation, as if pouring out his frustration in the school's music room, shakes the heart and mind of his classmate, Hwang Ina, who coincidentally passes by in hallway.
Ina, who has a special talent for art, wants to formally study art but is struggling with her family's difficult circumstances and her own heart that she herself can't even figure out.
Ina paints the emotions of that day, Choi Hwan sees it, and the two become intertwined through fate. 

The story of 15-year-old children who communicate, struggle, and grow through 'music' and 'art'.

(Source: Kidari Studio, translated)

*Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.*

display_title: The Spring Scent of the Sea
description:
A mermaid girl's parents get caught by humans so she sets out into the human world to find her parents.

(Source: Toomics)

The very last try for forgotten actresses. Here comes the "Top Secret Project!"

(Source: Lezhin X)

*"Everyone has someone who protects them. Except for me..."*

Am I really living according to my destiny?
Or can you change your own destiny?

A fateful meeting between a man who wants to escape fate and a guardian spirit who appears after 20 years.

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

We all want to run away once life starts to become a burden. We think we'll be able to let it go once we run from it, but our thoughts never go easy on us. Face your worries and fight, or let it devour you. This is a story about a man who tries to avoid his angony, but ends up facing it.

(Source: Toomics)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Eun-Sae and Joo-Hwan are the perfect couple--or so the world believes. Behind the façade lies a cold arrangement: a marriage of convenience orchestrated by two powerful families. But their carefully planned union takes a dramatic turn when Joo-Hwan is involved in a devastating car accident. As chaos unfolds, Eun-Sae's life spirals further into darkness when she is abducted by the enigmatic French mafia boss, Louis de Léon, and confined to his luxurious-yet suffocating-palace. Will she break free from her gilded cage, or will Louis's dark world consume her? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Through posting a "Best Comment", I somehow became the main character of a webtoon!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Soyou, who was a promising track and field athlete, lost everything due to acute heart disease. She was sentenced to death but miraculously survives with a heart donation. She loses everything she had built up and returns to high school a year later than her peers, but it is not easy for her to make friends or pursue her dreams. Then, in the new semester of the second year, the moment she sees a boy in the classroom, her heart suddenly races, and she feels like crying... The man she met in her dream that night introduces himself as the owner of the transplanted heart and the father of the boy she saw for the first time today. Isn't that something? His son, Jaeha, has lost his entire family and is alone in this world... At the man's request, Soyou gives Jaeha a message of support, and with each action, precious people are found in Soyou's empty life—reasons for life, relationships, and dreams. Soyou progresses slowly, but one by one, she learns how to live.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.*

A pleasant and mysterious daily life created by a young couple in the forest and an unidentified child who one day came to them. 

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

A scholar who failed the national exams is picked up by a martial arts master and given the task to record his life into a book. Through their journey, Son Bin meets many great people and soon finds himself following the same path as the master, as the Martial Arts King.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Jae-Kyung, who grew up under a perfectionist father, must keep first place in the entire school. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

An abused little girl with nothing to live for meets an old man with a nasty personality.

(Source: Daum, translated)

A scatterbrained, talentless civil servant returned as the heavenly Demon. He now wished to live the rest of his life peacefully, as his days in the Murim world were full of conflict and bloodshed. However... 

*"Please be my father until I graduate."* 

He suddenly gained a daughter out of nowhere.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The representative of "purity," and the nation's most popular actress, Yeo Goeun, and the twisted scandal maker, Seo Beomi. In truth, the two of them share a secret. They are "acting as best friends" due to their company's ruse. The two of them look extremely close and affectionate in the reality program, "The BFF Special," but all of this is an act! 

"I don't plan on becoming friends with you! E.v.e.r." "I don't plan on being friends with you either." 

In the beginning, they were busy being hostile to each other whenever they met. But as they filmed the show, the two of them became closer, and Goeun, who previously disliked Beomi, has a small change of heart… 

Beomi continues to approach Goeun, and it can't be told whether he realizes Goeun's feelings or not. The image of Beomi that appears in front of Goeun every time she desperately needs someone, and the image of him she saw in the pub before filming the show overlaps, bringing chaos to her mind. She had thought he was a person who wasn't serious about anything, but she becomes more and more shaken up as he shows his sincere sides to her… 

Can the two of them resolve their misunderstandings and move on from being "fake BFFs" into "real lovers?" 

*Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.*

Journey to find the power of the lost queen, their great adventure begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Blacked out from drinking, just what happened with his crush during that time...?! 

Dong Saebyeok, a scary-looking but softhearted guy who falls for his cool-headed junior, Seo Gwangchae. Watch their cute campus romance unfold because no matter how bad the day is, the sun always rises!

*"Hey, don't get confused. I've never thought of you as my little brother. You don't even know your right place."*

That was the dagger that hurt the most. Myeong-U Han. A child of a wealthy family with a quick mind. But God didn't give him everything. A near incurable genetic heart disease. He did his best in order to earn the respect of the people around him. But his father, the chairman, and his family members never took him seriously. That was when an accident suddenly struck him. And... he woke up in the body of the severely injured student, Cheo-Min Kim.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: Became the Chef of the Dragon King
description: Cheong Shim (a.k.a Cheongi (Cheong-i)) threw herself into the sea of Indangsu! What will happen when she wakes up in a lazy dragon's dungeon? Meet many cute monsters while living a delicious, symbiotic life!

The unpredictable trial of a girl who was nothing at school begins! 

Ordinary Park Ga-Eul witnesses the secret affair of Han Yu-Hyeon, who belongs to the so-called 'popular group', and uses this to blackmail Han Yu-Hyeon to join the group she admired...

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes 10 side story chapters*

Aideen, the esteemed daughter of a duke, is the Emperor’s assassin and the leader of ‘Owl.’ For giving everything and serving her Lord faithfully, she was betrayed and sentenced to death by guillotine. Abandoned by her Lord, her life came to an end, yet the moment she opened her eyes again, she realized she had returned to a time when she was still only 17. In order to get her revenge, she decided to destroy Ferdi, a country that the Emperor cherished more than his life.

*"You are beautiful, Milady. Especially those red eyes of yours."* 

The man who personally sent the order to have Aideen executed, the Prince from the enemy country, Diceon, unexpectedly began to interfere with her life! The story of Aideen, the woman who was abandoned by the Emperor and was given a second chance at life to get her revenge and to destroy her home country, now unfolds!

The bow is a weapon that dominates everything in sight, even for targets hiding at distances too far for the eyes to see. Just imagine a weapon you cannot even see targeting your life. What could possibly be scarier than that? A training regime from hell with a brutal grandfather. A joyful trip to Zhongyuan in search of a wife. The rise of a hero who will overturn the Murim world. Ki Guided Arrow - a fresh take on Ki Guidance that is stronger than both the Ki Guided Sword and Blade! Fire the arrow into tomorrow!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

The terror man and the revival man finally meet. "Destruction is the beginning of resurrection". The whole world is in danger with the birth of a new evil. Min Jeong-U has the ability to see misfortune and Seok-Hwan has the ability to come back to life. The two heroes made different choices... Who will be the final winner? 

Han Dong-U's and Ko Jin-Ho's first crossover work! 

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and epilogue.*

The day I accidentally met you, my story began to change.

(Source: Kakao Webtoons)

*Note: chapter count includes a 5-chapter side story*

Seulgi was no.1 in her old suburban school. Now, having transferred to the prestigious Chaehwa Girls’ High in Seoul, she must engage in fierce, friendly competition with her rich and talented rival Jay. 

(Source: YLAB) 

*Note:
\- Belongs to Blue String universe.
\- includes one extra chapter.*

A kind guy who has strived to turn himself into his crush’s ideal type over ten years. But one day, she says that she likes bad boys… *"From today onwards, I’m… going to be reborn as a bad boy."*

(Source: Naver, translated)

Though Chichi the cat looks very cute, he has one goal: eradicate humanity and take over the world! He decides to recruit comrades to aid him in his quest, but it looks like world conquest won't be that easy?! Follow the adventures of Chichi the ~tyrant~, Dunno, the dog who loves humans, and Kaiser Kang Taeshik, the hard-boiled wild hamster, as they face many hardships on their path to absolute dominion! 

*Note: The chapter count includes 8 side stories.*

Eun-Gi has been in college without being engaged with others. One day by encounter, he finds the secret of underclassman Jeong-Woo. Why are you so nervous to forget? A love story that’s both easy and difficult.
The special discipleship of Mu-Rim's best assassin, Gwi-Myeon-Dok, will begin.

A refreshing story of love and passionate detectives solving the biggest cases in all of South Korea! In the Korean Police Department, there is a team in charge of investigating violent and special crimes. Directly from the “Violent 01” team, Detectives Han Jeoung-yu, our prodigy son, and Seo Haeso, wild mad dog, make their appearance! Ready for anything to find answers! From infiltrating a club frequented by the most powerful businessmen in the country to ... Competing in a passionate kissing contest for a luxury watch?! Get ready! That your covert mission… is about to begin!

(Source: KTOON, translated)

Woken up from a date, he’s suddenly in a movie set? Wait, he’s been reborn as a baby martial artist! In the Jongnam Clan, which was once one of the 9 strongest clans, he receives the name “Gun-Chung” and uses the knowledge of his past life to learn the true meaning of martial arts. When your perspective is different, your martial arts changes. Armed with knowledge, Gun-Chung brings about a new age of martial arts!

The life of an ordinary beta is overtaken by an omega!
Who is he that only Mr. B doesn't know?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

In the second half of the 2nd century, Naru, a warrior from the state of Koryo, was sold as a gladiator-slave to the Roman Empire and waged a desperate struggle for freedom. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

This is a world whose peace was destroyed by the Shadow Lord, ‘Secneum’. ‘Niro’ is a half-elf, half-human boy who lost his parents as a baby and was adopted by a slave couple. In this world, slaves are not treated as humans. Since Niro’s adoptive parents are slaves, they are mistreated and eventually lose their lives. Now Niro is alone once more, and must shoulder the burdens of his family and do whatever is takes to protect his two younger siblings. If Niro wants to escape this fate, there is only one thing he can do. He must graduate from the academy, ‘Excanum’ just like the current Emperor, ‘Muren’ who was once a slave!

Kim Gun, a late-night snack deliveryman preparing for the high school graduation exam. One day he goes to the wrong address, and there he encounters a woman who is believed to be a vampire. 

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

You, who in the manhwa that I draw, can we meet beyond this squared space that I created?

(Source: KToon, translated)

Rembrary, the deputy of God loved by all and the holy high priest. When I woke up while fighting against the Demon King who invaded my world, I woke up as an underrated idol in Korea..! 

Will he be able to safely adjust to the idol life and return to his original world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*“I told you I would remember you.”*
*“It’s good to see you again, crown prince.”* 

There is a girl named Kyungmin with a special talent of time traveling in the Republic of Korea in 2020. One day, Kyungmin meets the 18-year-old Prince Gwanghae, who came to the present from the Joseon era. 

Although it was only for a single day, the two of them leave each other with unforgettable memories. 

After returning to Joseon, Prince Gwanghae is unable to forget Kyungmin for a long time, and waits for her while dreaming of reuniting with her. 

And due to her father’s sudden death, Kyungmin carries out a life-threatening time-traveling journey. And there, she meets the 27-year-old Gwanghae.

Seo Geun-Woo is a perfect top star, he got it all, looks, posture, aura, eliteness, you name it… He is usually picky and hard to please, especially to any movie that he attends to. Until one day, a newcomer actress Min Seo-Yeon caught his eye, for some reason he can’t fathom what about with this girl that his usual compose self is faltering in the presence of this Lady, makes him uncomfortable but in a pleasant way… Is this what they call love? A Story with romance for all ages.

Ho-Rang, a pretty fox spirit, loses his fox pearl and gets kidnapped. Lee Ju-Hwa, a wolf hybrid, appears in front of him with overflowing Yang energy. If Ho-Rang seduces and drains the overflowing Yang energy out of Ju-Hwa, he would be able to retrieve his fox pearl more quickly! Can Ho-Rang safely do it and return to his hometown?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

The state of Joseon is defeated by the invaders of the royal family.

Two girls are born with a power that both the emperor and his traitors can use. Will this light illuminate the chaos of the times that have come? Or will it be the reason an entire country burns out?

… A new story begins!
184 cm tall and known by the titles of “flower boy beauty” and all-around male fashion model is actually a girl!

He fought like a demon to survive. And survived. A task force that lives on a mission and dies on a mission! You’re lucky to survive this time, but there’s no guarantee that will happen on your next mission. Next time, like allies who did not return from this mission, they may be treated as deserters and disappear as crow food in an unknown valley. The breathtaking smell of blood! Abigail’s scream! Now I want to shake off all that and become the wind. I want to become a breeze and move freely around the world. Lonely but not lonely, invisible but all-enveloping, telling many things but not speaking of one’s thoughts… …. I want to live like that.

**Original Novel:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/46817474), Naver Series, [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1356000034), [MrBlue](https://m.mrblue.com/novel/detail/dailybooks0002)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue (Webtoon)](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_poong_wz), [MrBlue (Manhwa)](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000048076), [MrBlue (Special Set)](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056820), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55722226)

**Official Translations:**  
[Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/action/soul-of-the-wind/list?title_no=4616), [French](https://fr.piccoma.com/fr/product/613)

*“Without human faith, we cannot exist.”*

Shin Seonnyeo was born with shaman power, but she refused to be a shaman. One day, two deities came and asked her to become a shaman.The deities offer to grant her a wish if they can regain their old power. Can Seonnyeo spend a peaceful life after school?
Are we playing hide and seek? Who's hiding this time? Am I the seeker? Follow this topsy-turvy journey, with mind-bending plot points, and places where you'll scream "Found you!"

Tae-Jin, who lost motivation in everything and drifted away, receives an offer from Shin Sang-Yun, the former captain of the wrestling club at Dangyeong high school, and eventually compromises with reality and enters the world of fists. 

And as he adjusts to that world, he gradually begins to feel that he is falling into the abyss... 

The saddest story of the Dokgo series unfolds.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*"I like that sunbae who looks good in glasses!!!"* 

Sungbin, who has a glasses fetish, has a one-sided crush on his sunbae, Ahn Gyunghoon, who looks good in glasses. Gyunghoon mistakes Sungbin to be a stalker as he suspiciously lingers around him. 

The moment Gyunghoon throws Sungbin out, a drunk Sungbin confesses his feelings. To Sungbin who clings onto him saying he likes sunbae who looks good in glasses, Gyunghoon gives a headbutt but...

A warrior who was slaughtered at the hands of his comrades after having saved the world from monsters, wakes up in an unknown world after his death. 

After attaining a second chance at life, he vows to live his life in debauchery, but the way his savior gazes at him... is somewhat strange. 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 2 side stories.*

"The negligence is not the fault of the master but of the servant".

Marie, who will be punished in place of the Lady Alex who has no head for studying! As the hem of her long skirt is lifted, her beautiful and porcelain legs are revealed, the whip slashing through the air leaves painfully red marks on Marie's thin legs.

Don't hit poor Marie. I should be the one to stop it. Huh? What? Something's strange? Why is my heart pounding? 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
The tale of Suk-Gyeong, a ghost no one pays attention to, who's been sitting in school for the last twenty-seven years.

display_title: Lord Baby Runs a Romance Fantasy With Cash
description:
This is a promotional oneshot for a novel of the same name.
I lived suffering without a home, religion, or parents, but an angel appeared and reincarnated me.
"You, a pro when it comes to romance fantasy novels, would you like to reincarnate in a world that was created based off of a romance fantasy novel?"
I reincarnated because he said I would have a (handsome) dad and a (handsome) older brother who would spoon feed me, and even gift me a diamond mine, but… –I might be a child from my mother's affair? As soon as I was born, I was sent to my mother's household and fell into a family that deprives me.
"If I stay like this, I might end up freezing or starving to death by myself!"

A world where 11 Kings with absolute reign live protected by knights. Apprentice knight Hinta, together with his partner Kanut, venture on a journey to become appointed as formal knights. An action-packed fantasy story of two boys as they fight to become real knights!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo Moon Moo-hui, who had no choice but to look at the world with a different eye from his childhood, unfolds a new world from the tip of his brush, who unexpectedly went out to Kang-Ho! 

(Source: Kakao, translated)

display_title: I adopted a villain as my father
description:
I entered a novel in which the heroine who reincarnated as a saintess has to walk on a thorny path. ‘Yeah, nope!’ I, who decided to walk on a flower path, abandoned the original frustrating family and adopted my bias as my dad in our first meeting. 

“You, be my daddy!” The story’s final boss and villain! But now he’s just my dad. Fufu. “Daddy, why is your name also daddy? So cute.” 

“What did you eat for breakfast? Handsomeness?” {a pun that I’m too lazy to explain} As I dream of a happy ending for Daddy, there’s just one more huge obstacle… The existence of the hero who would kill the final boss. Now that it’s come to this, let’s save my bias and the hero as an addition! If I have time, maybe the world too! However… 

“I’ll kill you if you approach my daughter.” …Daddy keeps on raising the death flags. “You should take responsibility since you tamed me.” Somehow the hero is also obsessed over me, just what’s going on…? 

*Note: This is a one shot promotional manhwa for the novel of the same name.*

Park SungAh is a high school student by day and shaman by night. In the shaman's eyes, the people who are close to death walk upside-down... And one of these people is her crush! 

*Note: The chapter count includes 14 extra stories.*

*"My partner is just a male friend."*

So-mang Park wants to have a relationship at least once in her teens. But true love leading to a dreamy romantic marriage is just a crazy delusion that'll never happen. In reality, So-mang Park and the word "date" just don't belong together. Then one day a ray of hope shines upon her. Is this what flirting is? This is a story of a cheerful yet delusional girl's quest for romance.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes an epilogue.*

The God who rules over the vast world of 'Rodowan' one day announces a new Divine Law: All reproduction is immediately prohibited.

Those who are banned from conceiving rebel for the sake of humankind and their children, but the power of God and their followers is overwhelming and oppressive.

God brands children born after the Divine Law as children of traitors, killing them or turning them into slaves.

In this chaotic world, those who wish to punish this sick tyranny begin their desperate fight.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

It's been 2 months since Ha Yun-Seo learned that Seo Ju-Won, her lover of three years, is the youngest son of a chaebol.

She receives money in exchange for breaking up with her boyfriend, so she attempted everything to make him break up with her, but Ju-Won never stopped pursuing her, trying to change Yun-Seo's mind...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Judge Lee, who believed justice could be realized in the courtroom, did not follow the orders of his superiors and sentenced the conglomerate to life in prison before being killed. But is it because of the shenanigans he heard as a child? With all his memories, Lee gets a second life chance. The world needs him, Lee, the heretic of the judiciary, who knows only justice.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Min-Seong is the most popular and dominant Alpha at the school. One day, he lost his inhibitions and went into heat and had a one-night stand without thinking... The other person was In-Seo, who was taking the same liberal-arts class as him, and Min-seong fell in love with In-Seo because of his bright personality. Min-Seong thought it was a natural meeting between Alpha and Omega, but In-Seo was a beta...?! 

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Jin and Junghyeok are childhood friends, but they have been in a cold war for years! What happens when their souls swap? One day, both of them found their old name tags from middle school and went to bed with old memories in mind... to wake up in the body of the one that they hate the most! How will they deal with day to day life? Is there a way back?

display_title: I Became the Black Swan Mother of the White Swan Princess
description:
The possession that happens to others befell on me too. I’m pretty sure that I’m a supporting character… But what on earth is this novel? On top of being a widow with stepdaughters of my age, I’m living a cursed life in which I transform into a black swan every night because of black magic! I need to suppress my tears and change my fate… Not. Why should I? Why so serious? A duchess by daytime, and a carefree queen of the lake by nighttime. Bravo, my destiny! Life should be spontaneous! As much as I wished to continue living like this, I chanced upon a white baby swan. 

*“Mommy, awe you weally my mommy?”*

What, you’re a human? And the tyrant emperor’s youngest sister moreover?

*“I’m not your mommy! Can’t you tell from the colour of our feathers?”* 

I’m a black swan, you’re a white swan! But why’s she so freaking adorable?! As we endure the obsession and persecution(?) of her seven older brothers, including the tyrant emperor, can our mother-daughter love ever be fulfilled? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“I need your help, assistant manager. By that… I mean sexually.” 

A sad office worker by day, reigning dom by night! Yang-Hwa, who lives a risqué double life, has another secret. Her gender changes whenever she has an orgasm, and the only way to change back is to have another orgasm… But why… did I have to have an orgasm with my irritating boss, assistant manager Kang, of all people…?! 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

A the terrible murder surrounding a broadcast jockey involving the video editor-in-charge... What is the truth behind it?

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

Rising stars and longtime childhood friends, So Dakyung and Ji Minwoo. The scandalous open 'business relationship' is rapidly evolving to 'marriage'! But somewhere in this whole marriage, is something a little suspicious. 

*"Before the summer you turn 29, you must succeed in marrying So Dakyung."* 

What kind of story did he have with his old note? 

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: The chapter count includes 3 side stories.*

Yeon-Ju and Jae-Ho are business and sex partners. Their partnership is shaken by a blind date proposal sent by Jae-Ho's friend pretending to be Jae-Ho to Yeon-Ju.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

display_title: Who Did You Do It With
description:
Jong-seok returned to his hometown after living in Seoul for a long time. He is having a good time meeting the girls from his memories. But then he gets a strange letter...

*“You didn’t forget to take responsibility, right?”*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
Yul Lee is a bank clerk with an ordinary life. But she ends up switching bodies with a handsome moneylender...?

Noh So-ha lives an ordinary life as a boatman. But his true identity is that of the heir to the legendary Gupa Sword Technique. Now, his quest for the “Seongeun-gyeong,” a secret text left behind by Emperor Qin Shi Huang, begins.

Source: Naver, Translated
The moment I looked Death in the eye, I made a contract with the Lord of the Underworld.

display_title: Does the Lord's Coin Not Shrink?!
description: **Note:** This is a one shot promotional manhwa for the novel of the same name.

A twisted school romance of someone who can "truly be mine" and love me to death.

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

'Changsu' is a great start-up with the saying that the health center is the trend. However, the sales rise vertically when a deficit is lost due to the lack of sales, and an Albanian who has a sensual body! What is the secret of her suspicious business?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Sun-Hee's family seems to be a perfect, happy family. 

One day, Sun-Hee confesses that she killed her friend, Kyung-Ho, but her mother's reaction is somewhat strange. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

"If you wish to return, then you must find all the stones of the Dragon's Heart!" And so, Lee started his adventure to become an unparalleled mage. Which bonds will he find? That's all up to him, to discover...

I remember the story of a novel I had read in my previous life just before my marriage. If you don’t mess up the wedding, you’ll be poisoned by your husband! So I just kissed the pastor who was in charge of the ceremony. 

*"Commander, are you alright?"* 

One of the holy knights shouted as he approached the pastor who was kissed. 

*"Huh, what?"
"Wait... are you the commander of the Holy Knights?"* 

\*\*\*\* 

Rurutia, who was about to die, wanted to spend her last moment in a temple where she felt at ease the most. She started a business with her friends for the temple, and it was a big hit. 

*"Miss, you have the world in the palm of your hands!"
"Are you a God who descended to earth?"* 

In the midst of being embarrassed by the large crown, the commander of the holy knights himself was also acting strange. 

*“All I wish for is to be your husband.”,* he said that with eyes shining with obsession.
*"Take responsibility for stealing my first kiss."* 

This is all so wrong. It seems that I changed my future.

Ahyeon, who has never felt the true romance of a relationship, resented God as she feared that she might forever be alone. But all of a sudden, she started winning over a number of guys...? 

(Source: Never, translated)

An ordinary college student, "Ye-Seul", starts a part-time job at a broadcasting station cafe to meet "Min-Jun", the youngest main news announcer in South Korea, who is also known as a spy. Contrary to her expectations, Kim Min-Jun is a very cold person... 

"Do you know how long I've liked you? Why are you being so cold towards me?"

(Source: Naver, translated)

Revenge and love of the last remaining werewolves!

Luna, the youngest prince of the Airoon Kingdom, is kidnapped by mysterious gangsters while on his way to an allied Qatar country against a strategic marriage. Luna, dragged by the kidnappers' chief, promises to do whatever it takes to save the life of the injured maid on his behalf, begging the boss for her life...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Shine Kim, whom transfer student Seon Yu-Byeol likes, is a famous running star at school. He has a handsome face, great athleticism, and even an evil girlfriend!
'If I get a little bit faster than I am now, and if I get to be faster than Shine Kim, will you look at me?'
A youthful growth drama about Seon Yu-Byeol, a running genius who is more interested in ash than running, Shin Kim, a running fool who only knows about running, and boys and girls in the athletics club. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Nam Ji-il, an ordinary student who entered Daemyung High School, famous for being bad. From the first day of admission, he became the target of ILJIN and became a bread shuttle known to all students. 

A weak body with chronic heart disease, assaulted and bullied by ILJIN, and the painful days are repeated.
BaekSeul, high school freshman and former soccer ace, was about to confess to her sunbae but ended up becoming a master airsoft player?!

Yoon Hana finds out that her family is moving out just before the high school entrance ceremony. At first she as worried about transferring to a new school, but her bright personality prevents her from being depressed for too long. However, the first day at the new school doesn't go quiet well how she would imagine. She quickly encounters trouble with her intimidating desk mate, Lee Chang-wook! But soon Hana starts to learn that there's more to Chang-wook than meets the eye. This is the story of the sunny Hana's project to help the gloomy Chang-wook make friends!

Seo Yi-Hwan, the youngest daughter of a conglomerate. She, a close friend, and a world-renowned pianist have enjoyed dangerous times committing themselves to promiscuous parties and drugs together. But soon, the walls of trust they've built slowly begins to crack as the mysterious girl, Yoo Se-Rin appears in the lives of the two men. Who is is this new mysterious girl?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Gitaek always dreamed of being in a relationship with someone who’s his ideal preference: caring, thoughtful and has a good body. After being absent for a while, he goes to his club’s meeting room and finds a new student—Jungwoo—who fits this preference and ends up confessing to Jungwoo while he’s drunk. Jungwoo is touched and a little flustered by the first confession he has ever received but, while getting to know each other, Jungwoo finds out that Gitaek’s drinking habit is confessing… 

Can the two have a happy ending after an unintended push and pull? 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated) 

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*

Kang In-Young, betrayed by his friend and his lover, is framed for murder and is thrown into prison. There he meets a fellow prisoner, an old man who used to be a petty thief. Turns out he stole a secret martial art from JeonJin sect, and to escape their pursuit, he intentionally broke the law to enter the prison and spent 30 years honing the secret martial skills. Tragically the old man catches a plague-like disease and is going to die… but after observing Kang, he decides to make him his heir and gives him the secret martial arts. 10 years after the old man's death he fully masters the secret art…

Behavior and manners always seem to change. Who are you? 

(Source: Naver, translated)

In the near future, the education system has evolved into a military competition between youths over the domination of others. The stakes are high here: the winner takes all from the loser. Schools are now mobile buildings that host their students, which are able to summon weapons of varying power and shape to battle each other. Mabaram starts from the bottom in this system and won't let his school, Metro, go down without a fight. He will have to pair up with an unexpected transfer student to assimilate other schools in order to reach the tallest heights of the rankings.

I’m a witch that’s over 300 years old, but I died at the hands of a human I’d trusted. I thought I’d be stuck in the spiritual world forever, but I reincarnated as the princess of a violent and bloody imperial family, where siblings would murder each other for the throne. 

Honestly, at this rate, I should just become the next emperor. I’ll conquer the entire continent and attain my sweet revenge on Lacuz. And so, I turned to evil and wicked ways, as befitting my role as a witch. I even won over the princes with my overwhelming strength. So I thought that everyone would fear me, but… 

(Source: Kakao, translated and edited)

*Note: Promotional one-shot for the homonym web novel.*

In order to help the nine-tailed fox find the elixir of life, the fox demon 'Seoyo' sneaks into the palace. But who appears in front of Seoyo, who was wandering around looking for the magical herb? A girl called 'Elixir of Life'?! Seoyo, curious about the human elixir of life, begins to hover around her, and the two girls begin to open their hearts to each other... 

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue*

After dying from overwork in her previous life, Beth finds herself in the world of a novel she was reading. While she's reborn as an unimportant side character, she ends up working for the house of the novel's villain, the strict Lady Claire. There, she witnessed first-hand the abuse and negligence a young Claire goes through and decides to stop her from becoming the main character! 

*Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the novel of the same name.*

A killer who can completely conceal all traces of his existence has been hired to deal with the target while keeping a low profile. However, the place where the killer infiltrated was an apartment in Korea that had poor soundproofing levels. Everyone can hear everything that is happening in the apartment. It is in this place that the killer is to monitor the target until given further instructions. All he wants to do is to complete his mission in peace. However, things just won't go his way.

On her wedding night, the virtuous woman Park Yeon-U suddenly lost her husband. To make matters worse, she was kidnapped by a villain and thrown into a well, only to wake up in 21st-century South Korea…?! To make matters worse, the man who rescued her, a dead ringer for her husband, proposes a fake marriage! The bold and virtuous Lady Park Yeon-U and the confirmed bachelor Kang Tae-Ha enter into a contract marriage of conflicting dreams.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.*

*“Your game ends here.”*

Every 100 years, in a competition that will grant them more than one wish, there is only one final winner. The young boy Han Si-Joon jumps into a fierce battle while risking everything to save his family.

(Source: Naver, translated)

On Christmas Day, 14 years ago, Jun-Yeong and Eun-Hyeok became step-brothers after their parents remarried. However, their parents soon passed away in a car accident and Eun-Hyeok became the only person Jun-Yeong could depend on. To Jun-Yeong, Eun-Hyeok was the perfect guardian as well as savior. But upon a certain incident, Eun-Hyeok's existence took on a different meaning to Jun-Yeong. That incident had Jun-Yeong leaving Eun-Hyeok's side as if he was running away, and now that 6 years have passed, he ends up reuniting with Eun-Hyeok at a hotel. As Eun-Hyeok, who had desperately looked for Jun-Yeong, finds and warmly hugs his little brother, his eyes show nothing but iciness unlike the warmth of his embrace...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Seung-Won, who lost his memories in a car accident, possesses the body of Chu Sa-Hyeok, a supporting character in the novel "Jegal Unhwi". As soon as he opens his eyes, Seung-Won was having an affair with Ha Ji-Kwang, despite being completely oblivious to it and is under the impression that he is dreaming as he's on the verge of death. Somehow, he is unable to wake up from his dream and continues to live on as Chu Sa-Hyeok. 

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

A noble man in silk clothing appears in front of the fifteen year old Eun Hong, who is about to be sold off to the Courtesan house due to her father's debts. He was the same man who occasionally bought the straw shoes that Eun Hong sold at the market. After coming across him at the courtesan house, Eun Hong is sold off to him for a handsome sum of five hundred taels... 

Choi Taewoong, the 21 year old leader of the Fire Dragon Trade business, the largest business in Joseon. He buys and sells everything with money, but will he be able to buy a bride with money as well?

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

In hopes of getting close to his estranged friend, Se-Gun, Nan-Woo decides to work part-time at the bakery run by him. However, Nan-Woo, who visits Se-Gun during his rut, manifests as an omega for the first time in his life. The two intoxicated people indulge in a moment of physical ecstasy... 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

There is no need to state the simple truth in large sentences. I am the greatest in the world. 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Rae rejects an invitation to go to a semester-end party from the most popular student on campus, Sungwoon, but what happens when Rae's new part-time job is at a strange bunny boy costume bar... and his customer is a drunk Sungwoon?!

If I met you again, would I be able to make a different choice?

A reunion with my first love.

One day, the future is captured by a camera picked up by accident?! 

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

My day always starts with 'Today's Fortune'. I follow whatever it says including lucky colors, places, and objects. What?! I'm going to receive a love confession today? I've been waiting all day, but there's no news. Suddenly Eunchan, the most popular boy in school, confesses to me!

The witch "Lyla" who studies pleasure, buys a rare red-eyed black wolf while looking for familiars so that she could further her research. Lyla brought the wolf home and fell asleep but then is attacked by a wolf who turned into a man! However, she is able to skilfully subdue the attack... 

Join Lyla on her journey as she begins to establish the hierarchy for a bound, but still rebellious familiar!

*“Gu-Ho, can you help take a look at mine?”*

Gu-Ho and Yun-Ji were reunited as new employees at BS Electronics. Yun-Ji, who is famous for her beauty, approached him affectionately, and Gu-Ho, with his open-mindedness, devotes himself to her. But Yun-Ji’s intentions for Gu-Ho weren’t as affectionate as it seems, as she approached him from the start to make use of Gu-ho...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

*"100 days left, and I'm still a virgin"* 

Kun-Hee is a 21-year-old university student. He has a girlfriend but is still a virgin because her, Goo-I, said that she will be a virgin until marriage. Instead of a girlfriend showing no sign of permission, a tempting offer comes to Kun-Hee, in a hurry before enlistment...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

“Jiyeon, why are you at my house…? What is this when you return home after being discharged from the army? An eleven-year-old sister lives in without a word. The cohabitation started without a warning was caused by a little sister like a beagle. It’s just getting dizzy, and to make matters worse, I enrolled in a university and stayed there all day, 24 hours a day…

[Original Webtoon](https://toptoon.com/comic/ep_list/sister)

'Im Rok' has the nickname 'Lucky Deer', always with good luck. As usual, he won an event and went on a trip with his friends. He is invited to the island of Noah, a handsome and kind man. Luxurious islands and homes, they can't stop at Noah's hospitality. However, oddly enough, each of his friends disappeared, and to make matters worse, Imrok was freaking out underground.

An assassin of the Murim Alliance that inherited the work of a Demonic Cult Leader.

He stands up after being down and out, and gets out into the Jianghu! This is the incredible Jianghu journey of the world’s best Assassin, Lee Gwang. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Casanova, Bliss Ackland is the second son of the Ackland family, a U.S real estate famous conglomerate, top analyst who conquered the show business and also constantly having rumours with Hollywood female celebrities.  
During his college days, he came out with "one meter male access ban" which led him to be attacked by various human rights association. But no one would have thought that Bliss Ackland who was a true hetero suddenly coming out as gay!  
The media is constantly talking about the hot issue that's happening in the U.S., but in reality, it was just a play made by Bliss using his old friend Jin Cayman, who grew up like a family to avoid the confession of the underage daughter of a mafia boss whom he met at a social party.  
It's a gossip that will eventually calm down in a few days , but for Jin, who secretly have feelings for Bliss for 7 years is not happy with the situation but actually Bliss had been constantly courting Jin for the past 10 years...?!

[Original Web Novel (e-books)](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434012775)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1434009079), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/gossip/), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/gossip), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8557967), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/59935359)

**Official Translations:**  
[S.Chinese](https://m.kuaikanmanhua.com/mobile/6944/list/)

Strict and elite employer Gyuyeon who is works at the head of legal team of the big company, he hurriedly go to the hospital after he heard about his 18th year friend and first love Taewoo’s car accident. Taewoo who is having a financial difficulties, because he left with the baby and lost his wife by car accident, Gyuyeon who knows about this offered to Taewoo to live with him at his place for the time being...
A story that reincarnates as a happy [supporting] in a friend's novel, but takes on the misery of [the main character].

Min-Jae finds Jin-Hyeok, the breathtakingly handsome and personable new employee, very likable. After Min-Jae gets drunk during a company dinner, Jin-Hyeok helps Min-Jae solve a little problem he has...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Jegalgil, an asthma patient, desperately learns MMA to avenge his brother, who was also an MMA fighter. An intense process of battles unfolds. Fighting and defeating countless strong players, He sets out to finally challenge Kaiser's world heavyweight MMA champion 'River Dark Geseira'

(Source: Naver, translated)

*"Let’s go, babe.”*
*“Excuse me?? I was just making my way through!!"*

Si-Hyuk, who was able to get a studio with good conditions, suffers from insomnia due to frequent lovers' quarrel from the couple next door. 

Then one day, he runs into the couple who happened to be having a dispute out in the hallway. 

Si-Hyuk gets involved with one of the two, Jae-Hee, and ends up becoming his pretend lover. 

With Jae-Hee’s ex, So-Wool, being obsessive with Jae-Hee and acting like a stalker, what kind of fate awaits for Si-Hyuk and Jae-Hee who got into a pretentious relationship to shake So-Wool off...?

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

Yu-Jun and Geon-U have been a couple for 3 years. While Yu-Jun worries that Geon-U might have gotten tired of their time together, he looks for ways to spice up their relationship in colorful ways. A feast of a couple's sweet play! 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

The "Ten Masters" had kept each other in check and maintained the balance of power and order of the world beyond human limits, until Baek Do-Hyeon showed up with the strongest power ever! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

"...I'm screwed."
