On a normal day like any other, Duchess Juliana Auburn woke up from a dream. No, rather, it is I, "Isian," who remembered my past life. 

Juliana Auburn was a character in a novel who did nothing but badmouth and find fault with her husband, his friends, and her own father who had forced her to marry an illegitimate man. 

According to a spoiler comment that I read, she will be killed at the start of the novel. 

"Why did I only remember everything now after I've already done all of those bad things to the male lead?!" 

In order to avoid the novel's "bad ending," Juliana plans to divorce her husband, Evan, the male lead.... 

"I'll give you everything you want." 

"Don't you know that the one who falls in love first loses?" 

"Why should I apologize for staring at you because you're so pretty?" 

...Isn't my husband's obsession more serious than I thought?

display_title: My Contract as the Youngest Daughter
description:
Emily was a noblewoman who lost her father’s favor and even her life to her younger half-sister. She was killed by them and woke up in the past. Upon realizing this, she runs away from her noble family to save her life. However, while running away, she finds herself in danger of being kidnapped by an unknown assailant. But then, mysterious men who claim to be her ‘father’ and ‘brother’ suddenly appear?! 

 *“Take your hands off my daughter.”
“If you let my younger sister go, I’ll spare your life.”* 

My father isn’t that young. And I don’t have a brother…? How did it turn into this? Emily, the mistreated girl of the duke’s family, is reborn as Elizabeth, the pampered youngest daughter of a count. The new goal of her second life: eat well and live well! 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: This is the promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.*

There are people who own an object that shouldn’t exist in this world ‘OOPARTS’. They live in a border outside the world (Out), where many special stories are happening. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

A cafe in the mountains behind the school 

Rumors spread that there is a 'man who buys time' there.
A year ago, 'Yoo Narae', who was through an accident, went there with the Grim Reaper, 'Saewoo' and tried to steal time manager watch to come back to life...

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, Hae-Won, an ordinary college student, gets hit by a task and accidentally rips a stranger's shirt. To make matters worse, Hae-Won buried his face in his spacious chest! Uh? It's kinda big... Is that guy a fitness trainer? 

Hae-Won, who just registered at the gym, is feeling strange, can it be connected to U-Jin?

(Source: PeanuToon, translated)

So that girl finally grew up? My neighbor Ji-Eun suddenly came to share my room and motivate me sexually. I am Hae-Yeong, a student who is motivated because I will finally be able to have sex with my girlfriend Sena, after a long relationship, but... 

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Police officer Reinholt who went to a 5-star hotel for a vacation wanted a one night stand at first sight with a man who introduced himself as “Milo”. In that passing moment when Reinholt thought of how he wanted to have a special relationship with him, he saw Milo with an unusual crowd… Is that guy part of the mafia…? Even when Reinholt teld himself in his mind that he shouldn't, his heart was doing the opposite and it kept reacting to Milo. Kill or be killed… This is the dizzying romance between a police officer and a mafia!

Movie lover Seo Dong-Ju and genius composer Han Da-Un's first encounter couldn't be worse! But after they accidentally reunite at school and get acquainted, they grow more and more curious about each other... The two boys’ chaotic and heart-fluttering melody unfolds~

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Each novel often has its own world and many characters who live in it. However, apart from the main characters and their assistants, as well as several other minor personalities, we know nothing about them.  
"Cheundong, what level are you?"  
I have no idea who I am. I don't even know why they call me that. My entire story may be limited to the fact of entering a specialized military school. My line barely touches the main line, so my name is difficult to find on the pages of this novel.  
I'm just out of the story... or rather, I'm just one of many sets…

*This is the 2020 Version which was later cancelled.*

A time bomb-like game starts in a certain girls-only high school! Every time the final bell rings, one person's soul is stolen away. 

(Source: Hour of Lunacy)

The first-class honor student in the whole school, Lee Ha-Rin, has a perfect face, academic achievements and personality.
The eccentric transfer student who ends up sitting next to him says he's going to kill Ha-Rin from today?! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yoon Sun took a semester off after breaking up with his boyfriend Han Sunhwa. He is leading a jobless life when he comes to realize that his new neighbor, Goo Jae, was the part-timer at the cafe he used to frequently go. 

After going over to complain about a noise that kept going off in the middle of the night, the two end up becoming close as Jae approaches him amiably. However, Sunhwa claims he cannot forget Sun, comes to his doorstep, and Sun hears the most unexpected words from Jae but…

Is it true that a dragon-courted human has appeared?

He only went to see it once. In Akan's life, it doesn't matter whether a human being is beautiful or not, but after meeting Hereis, their lives become intertwined!

Will Hereis, with his fine body and full beauty, be able to capture Akan?!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.*

High-tech android-ai, gets into the world of martial arts due to crash landing and dimensional shift. Although he can cook food for the hungry, he will not even eat a piece himself (he is a robot) He will help people in danger, but he will never kill them (adhering to the three principles of robots) He never sleeps and never gets tired, people take him for a great hero ... Let's look at the adventures of a robot AI hero in the world of martial arts.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=787722), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=5699410)

Tai Lin, who was preparing for the national exam while working, was laid off and had to find another way to earn a living. One day, he found a high-paying but suspicious short-term part-time job, but the content of the job is sperm donation! Tai Lin, who went to the hospital to apply for a job, met the ideal perfect lover of his...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Weak-looking Hwasan doesn't seem to be a man that fights on the front lines. Instead, he is a brilliant man who passed the civil service examination twice due to his outstanding character. Furthermore, he is also respected for his close connections with various kings and officials. But his identity is none other than the only successor to the HwaSan sect. He usually stays in his room and reads. However, in the rare instances that he does use his body, it is only to clean the yard or do light exercises. One night, he shocked everyone by entering a conflict to save disciplines of the HwaSan sect and fought on the front lines. In that event, the ridge where the HwaSan sect was located burned to the ground, leaving their threshold destroyed. A bunch of fake masters appeared and massacred all of the disciples and even the young. In response, Hwasan displayed great combat skills to take them down and protect the disciples of the HwaSan sect. To find out the mastermind behind the attack and what their purpose was, Hwasan revealed his identity to the world. After hiding his identity for countless years, high-ranking officials and powerful forces began tearing each other apart, collapsed in front of him to make the Hwasan sect a powerful group

"Han Marie", a woman who wants to remember the scent of first love, and "Gil EunSoo" a man with the scent of first love. A story of the two who need each other.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%A7%90%ED%95%98%EC%A7%80-%EB%A7%90%EA%B9%8C/1875), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54338939)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/155023), [Thai](https://page.kakao.com/content/67034131)
*Note: Promotional prologue for the homonym web novel.*

Jung Dayeon, a webtoon artist and a cat owner saves a young heir from a dog and the next day suddenly a butler appears at her house, what's more the butler has cat ears and a tail?!

"I am Nyangjji from Planet Nya, a planet far from Earth. I have been ordered to be a servant here for one year."

A hilarious human documentary about cat butlers that appeared out of nowhere.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

A notorious hit group whose existence itself is veiled, boasts considerable power among the mafia with their perfect workmanship. 

In order to get those psychopaths with his own hands, Simone decided to enter the killers' den, just so he could avenge his sunbae. However not everything goes as planned...

*“Please help me… I’m stuck in time.”*

Taesu, a former detective who runs a crime report agency, comes to meet with Minjung, a lady customer. Minjung makes a ridiculous request. Taesu tries to chase Minjung away after hearing her absurd statements of being constantly trapped in the same situation. But the next words he hears lead him with no other choice to believe this situation…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Unpredictable superpowers suddenly arrived one day.

Wi Sang-U, a young teen with a bleak future acquires a useless power! But, will it really stay useless?

"Sunbae, what have you been up to these last few nights?"
Taeyoung, who is living with his hobae(his buddy), Junghoon, has a problem. He relieves himself while thinking of Junghoon every night, but can't finish. But what is..?! While they're drinking together, Junghoon offers to lend his hand...!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

"What!? You think I can’t do it just because I am a woman? Which year are we in?" 

On her first day at the prosecutor’s office for her internship, Choe Yeong-Hun is dismissed by Kim Yun-Jae, a popular prosecutor loved for his appearance and ability, who thought it was a male employee coming after looking at the name in the application…….. 

Can Yeong-Hun who thinks love is a luxury and Yun-Jae who doesn’t believe in love, be able to coexist peacefully? 

(Source: Naver, translated) 

*Note: The series went on a hiatus after the conclusion of the first season on April 2021.*

For some reason, Seo-Yeon begins seeing strange things. Ghosts appearing out of the blue are interfering with her work and love life, and she's on the brink of disaster! Hyun-U appears in a critical moment to help, but something feels off about this man who can banish ghosts with his fingertips.

*"Can I help you?"*

Hyun-U's gentle voice slowly shakes Seo-Yeon...

Her chilling yet sweet journey with the mysterious Mr. Lee begins now.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Yoonsu, the owner of a tailor shop who dreams of dressing the world’s most handsome men in perfect suits, meets Junho—a man who fits his ideal type to a T! Without hesitation, he shoots his shot: *“Please be my model!”*

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/aspiration), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/great_ambition)

**Official Translations:**  
[Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/aspiration), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/aspiration)

Choi Su-Won is a genius actor who really loves acting. Suddenly his life being stormed by a bad actor, Cha Ho-Yeong! I can't believed that my role was stolen by an actor with such bad acting. So, I was out for a drink and I don't remember how both of us could be in the same room, naked! But, even though I hate him... He's so handsome...!!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Seung-ah, who works a cosmetics company, recently participated in the Hotel Amenity contest held at the Seojin Hotel as a team project, but failed to make it out of the preliminaries. Seung-ah and her co-workers worked very hard in this contest came in an agreement to meet the officials of Seojin Hotel. Somehow, when they found out that there was something between Seung-ah and Seo Jin-hyung, the successor of Seojin Hotel, during the time at their university, they all counted on her. 

Seung-ah confessed to Jin-hyung because she loved him unrequitedly in college, but she didn't like it because she had a painful memory of being dumped. But, she took the courage for the company and contacted him. Of course, she thought she would be rejected, but Jin-hyung accepted the meeting and welcomed Seung-ah very warmly on the day they finally met. 

Jin-hyung brought up the story of the Seojin Hotel contest and said, "Seung-ah, I fell for you!" Why would a handsome chaebol heir, who should have nothing to worry about, do this to me?! 

(Source: Official Publisher, translated)

Minhyuk, who used to be an athlete, breaks his leg in an accident and faces difficulties in his relationship with his girlfriend Eunjin. In response, his friend Yoon-chan recommends a VR game he developed. Within this game he experiences new stimulation in a fantasy world that transcends reality…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

After suppressing the rebellion and putting in order another world, Namgun So Hwi returned to the world of Mu Rim. He walks through the world while hiding his strength that will shake the world of Mu Rim.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EB%82%A8%EA%B6%81%EC%84%B8%EA%B0%80-%EC%86%8C%EA%B3%B5%EC%9E%90/1947), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54836562)

***Note:** The title can also be NamGoongSaeGa is a Little Fauntleroy as 소공자 directly translates to Little Fauntleroy (a young manner boy)*

A sweet revenge brought about by a misunderstanding begins! 

Yu-Na, who has failed to register for classes and entered an unfamiliar classroom, bumps into Jung-Woo, who looks exactly like her best friend Ji-Soo's playboy ex-boyfriend, and they kiss by an unexpected accident. Jung-Woo misunderstands Yu-Na's actions due to his past experiences(?) and says, "I'll date you," so Yu-Na plans a grand revenge of 'seducing and dumping'...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

*Note: Includes 15 side story chapters.*

A pharmaceutical company started to secretly develop a new drug. The new drug's goal was to prevent humans from aging. They finally succeeded in developing the new drug after three years of research, but it couldn't be trusted without a clinical trial. Eventually, the researchers began testing the drug on people of unknown status illegally. As a result, 12 of the 20 subjects lost their body rhythm within a week and no longer aged. However, as the researchers became eager to report the findings, an unexpected change in the subjects' bodies began.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Georgia 2066, in a world overrun by a zombie epidemic, Ryu Kai has always admired Croix. He thought that their paths would never cross, but suddenly he is assigned a mission with him !! The implications will be more than unexpected….

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
Climbing to the top of Heaven’s castle will prove a herculean task, for the one who can reach the summit shall be granted control of the world.

Shin Chaekyung must accept the punishment of confessing to a senior on the new employee training night. The problem was, the manager she had to confess to was notoriously cold and not interested in women. After successfully confessing, Shin Chaekyung was held back by her manager, Jung Yunu. The manager made an interesting offer, which was for Chaekyung to be his shield at the office. Chaekyung, who is only a new employee, can't just refuse. How will Chaekyung's life be at the office?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55724921), [MComics](https://www.mcomics.co.kr/webtoonComic/11530), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/845039283), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/overwhelmi), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/overwhelming_you), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000058774), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10121219)

Nagyung couldn't contain her anger at the sound of moans coming from the next room every day. Let's knock on the door where continuous groans keep coming from. A naked neighbour greets us! A hot roco GL with a neighbour!

Gi-Tae and Seon-Woo decided to have their first hot experience on January 1st right after becoming adults. However, for some reason, Gi-Tae is late on December 31st. 

Will they be able to overcome this hardship and spend a fiery January 1st? 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

display_title: I Picked a Mobile from Another World
description:
In the midst of the devastation, only the soldiers’ bones remained.
It’s only a matter of time before the entire world is annihilated. To avoid this, Kyung-Hoon began searching for clues in another universe with the help of a ten-year-old phone he discovered in an abandoned building.

Venus loses his memories after an accident and dreams the same dream every day. In his dreams, the same person appears. Two people who want something back. Do they meet by coincidence? Or perhaps it is something more? 

(Source: Mr. Blue)

On the verge of death, I was saved by a group of elderly demon – level existences at the apex of cultivation. But I, Yeon-gang had too much potential in martial arts, and alas was kidnapped and forced to become their disciple… Join me as I desperately try my best to escape their grasp, and enter the world of Murim!

The forbidden ‘hole’ that every man has fantasized about at least once, that isn’t allowed even between lovers. This is the case with the main character, Sung Jaehee, until he goes to the hospital…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Mi-Young is my lovely girlfriend. She is an ardent environmentalist, and she tries to live frugally and recycle everything. Well, that's good so far... But sometime it seems like she actually loves the environment more than me?

After her third divorce, my mom kept changing through lovers and even keeps asking me for money. I couldn’t understand my mom and didn’t wish to live that way either. 

I believed that an ideal relationship and family that mothers dream of, doesn’t exist. 

But why… Why did you have to appear in my life again and make me unnecessarily hopeful?

My bias has an NSFW account?! 

Woo-Seok is a solo idol of three years who has been a big fan of an actor named Se-Ju. After having the chance to work on the same drama, Wooseok accidentally uncovers a secret of Se-Ju... By chance, Woo-Seok discovers an NSFW account with the same body as Se-Ju! 

Doubtful, Woo-Seok reaches out to Se-Ju, who confidently replies that it really was him on that account. 

To make his bias stop using the account, Woo-Seok promises to do anything Se-Ju wants but..

(Source: PeanuToon, translated)

Kang Sung-Tae, commissioned as a cadet officer, is unexpectedly transferred to a unit where his senior officer deserts. Because of this, his superiors begin to harass and suspect him from the very day he transfers. Stigmatized as a decommissioned officer, how will Second Lieutenant Kang Sung-Tae navigate this situation?

(Source: Naver, translated)

***Note:** Promotional oneshot for the novel.*

The greatest evil was resurrected, and the youngest high-ranked magician, Diarin, died three times while trying to stop it, and was unable to protect those close to her.

In her fourth reincarnation:  
Her life is at danger thanks to her eternal soul's fate, and she needs a different strategy to escape her future. Diarin promises divorce when she finds the prince that was engaged since he was a child, in exchange for him staying in her territory for one year. However...

...

Diarin leaned towards Yejet as best as she could, to try and look as natural as possible.  
"I will break the engagement for you."  
"Huh?" Yejet asked again, after blankly saying "Huh?" in the moment along with the driver.

Yejet's gaze was very peculiar. It was only thanks to Diarin putting in all of her focus on Yejet, that allowed her to just barely notice that odd gaze. Yejet didn't take his eyes off of Diarin's once.  
He asked her, "Are you talking about Duke Concul?"  
It was a sentence spoken as quietly as Diarin's. Excluding the driver, no one could hear their conversation.

"No way. Do you think the duke would actually let go of Your Highness? If he could, he would probably tie you up with a rope as tight as he could."  
"Then?"

Diarin in the quietest voice, as though ice might shatter if she spoke too loudly, "I'm talking about you."

[Promotional Webtoon/Novel](https://page.kakao.com/content/55318493/viewer/55334836)

***Artist(s):**  
Cover Artist: Yuun *
When I entered the same university as my crush, to be with him, I met a sunbae who has the same name as that of my dog?!

The timid Kyung-Tae-Tae, who can be seen everywhere, was often ignored by co-workers and neighbors. Then, one day, when he heard that sports dancing could make him popular with women, he gathered up the courage to enter the sports dance academy, when he heard a violent moan from inside the academy...!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

display_title: Why Are You Obsessed With Me Even Though I Reject Your Affection?
description:
The extra who sacrifices herself for the beloved female lead. Princess Shuelina who is tossed aside by her biologically related father and older brother. Now I’m the main character of this odd situation. In regards to hope, I’m still neglected at this orphanage. Just as I was going to run away before the imperial family found me– 

*“Did you hear? The House of Grand Duke Vailot came to sponsor an orphan.”* 

To find a way to live, I threw myself at the villain's family, the Grand Duke’s, and- 

*“You can do whatever you want. I, as the Grand Duke, will protect you.”* 

*“You’re not an orphan. You’re my younger sister.”* 

Why do they love me? 

Just as I made up my mind to live well since I'd already become a lady of the House of Grand Duke Vailot... 

*"I have searched for you for a long time, my child."* 

This time my biologically related father, the Emperor loves me. Why are you acting like this? I said, I don't need you guys who wouldn't have listened to what Shuelina had to say. I refuse to accept your love! 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Promotional prologue for the homonym web novel.*

*"This is her daughter?"* 

Tara, the illegitimate daughter of the noble Queen Adelaide, was thrown away as a baby and raised by poor relatives. They sent her to a notorious mage in the west named Judas, whom she had never met before. 

While she is overwhelmed by her so-called guardian's impossible beauty, he and the others in the castle treat her warily, hateful of the queen. However, the girl's lovable innocence and pitiful nature begin to melt the immortal magician's frozen heart... 

*“Stop acting cute. You’re like a vixen.”*
*“Why do you keep calling me a vixen?”*
*"I don't care if that child is broken. To me, life and destruction are one and the same."* 

A healing romance blooms between an obsessive and frigid 'guardian' that only shows kindness to one girl, and a little 'miss' scarred by her past.

For a long time, Jungmin has been in love with his friend. When suddenly, appearing before him is the unpleasant yet beautiful sunbae, Saro. 

*“I‘ll die if I don’t eat emotions”*

Ha On-Bit, a boy who suffered from heart problems after a car accident, has a dream where he is killed by an unidentified assailant. The relief of it being a dream only lasted for a moment, though, as On-Bit ran into that mysterious person exactly as it had happened in his dream. While he is running away, he comes to the realization that a deadly weapon that can destroy everything is inside his heart. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: I Don’t Want the Obsession of a Twisted Archduke
description:
I reincarnated as the wife of a cursed archduke in my own twisted novel. As the author, I took responsibility and set things right by lifting the curse, which was the key to returning home. I thought my job was done, and just when I was finally trying to go back, the archduke asked me, *"Did you really think I wouldn't know that you’re planning on returning to your fiance?".* 

He had completely misunderstood! 

*"Whether you like it or not, I'm still your husband. I'm never letting you go back to that bastard."* 

All I want is for him to please let me go home!

On the day he was going to confess, his crush told him he got a sex partner…! Jisoo has a crush on his longtime friend, Seojin. When Seojin goes to meet a sex partner, Jisoo tags along. When the situation becomes complicated, Seojin’s partner, "K", proposes an idea.

(Source: Korean publisher, translated)

The story of a passionate doctor, Yoon Ji-soo, who finds happiness by meeting Yoo Kang, a man who knows how to enjoy life.

(Source: Daum, translated)

"It'll be great if hyung can see me as an adult", worried Se-Hyun. There was no progress in the relationship with his seven-years-older lover, 'Gyeong-U'. 

Following his sister's advice, though, he made a plan to appeal maturely to Gyeong-U, it had not worked out well… At last, can they spend a lovely first day together?

(Source: Bomtoon)

Meet Leo, a stray cat who accidentally picks up an abandoned dog, Milky. 

To avoid a bad reputation from the other stray cats, Leo teaches Milky how to survive in the streets... But can he keep his cool through Milky's adorable demeanor? 

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Famous actor "Milan" likes to drive a scandal. Again this time, it's with a new bodyguard named "Lukas" who was assigned to him.
Lucas reveals that he has longed for Milan since he was a child, despite suffering from terrible pranks since his first day at work.
Milan, who unwittingly lifts his guard when he sees the pure, clear eyes of Lucas, seduces Lucas with alcohol...

The child of a prophecy is born to save the world. *"I need to get married to save people...? I'll do the marriage!"* The emperor is a young and innocent boy. But... My father interfered with my marriage! *"I can't give you my daughter! She will not be becoming empress."* *"Is my sister just a toy to you?"* And my brother too! 

Will I be able to save the world? 

**Note:** This is a one-shot promotional manhwa for the novel of the same name.

"Would you like to try a threesome?“ 

In-Hyeok, Su-Won, and Yu-Bin, who have been friends for 10 years, are living together. In-Hyeok witnesses Yu-Bin trying to kiss Su-Won while he is sleeping. In the process of trying to cover this up, Yu-Bin, who wanted to sleep with Su-Won, ends up suggesting a threesome? 

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

*Note: Contains three extra chapters.*

display_title: Don't Be Obsessed With a Spirit Like Me
description: *Note: Promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.*

*Note: This is a promotional oneshot.*

[Promotional Webtoon/Novel ](https://page.kakao.com/viewer/%EB%A7%A4%EB%8B%AC%EB%A0%A4%EB%8F%84-%EC%86%8C%EC%9A%A9%EC%97%86%EC%96%B4/%EB%A7%A4%EB%8B%AC%EB%A0%A4%EB%8F%84-%EC%86%8C%EC%9A%A9%EC%97%86%EC%96%B4-%ED%94%84%EB%A1%A4%EB%A1%9C%EA%B7%B8-%EC%9B%B9%ED%88%B0/55774055)

The love of my life, Rakan, became the Emperor. At last, the coronation ceremony; I stood by him expecting to become Empress. However, the crown of empress didn't become mine, it became Vienna's, my younger cousin.

I threw everything away to make Rakan the emperor, and all that's left for me ahead was death. It wasn't until I was abandoned that I realized he used me. Everything was a ruse. The carefully planned screenplay; its main characters being the love of my life, Rakan, and my cousin, Vienna. I was the only one who didn't know that. In my last moments, I made a promise. If I had another chance, I wouldn't love you again, even if I died.

I've miraculously returned to the past! To when I was 18, the day all the disharmony began.

I made up my mind in tears. This time, I'm going to give everything I've got to destroy you, Rakan. In my vow of revenge, I began to see something I had never noticed before. My fiancé, Paylon, has always looked my way.

"Please be on my side. I don't need love."

I'm not going to let you hang on to me this time!

When I opened my eyes, I had become the heroine of a romance comic! 

I may have become the heroine, but I prefer the second male lead!

Beginner skills Lv.999! The adventure of a Tutorial NPC who has an ego! 

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: Don't Let Go of the Leash
description:
An old elementary student who used to have a crush on me is now an intern at the company I work for?!

Manager Park Hyun-Soo, who just dreamed about an incident that happened a long time ago, hears that the chairman's son is coming to work at the company as an intern. But the tall and handsome intern 'Kang Joon-Wong' was the elementary student who confessed to him beforehand?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

*Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.*

Everyone loves her, so everyone hates her. Her name is ‘Bible.’ Her college life is getting complicated amidst the unwanted love and hatred. “I love you, Bible.”. 

(Source: YLAB) 

*Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.*

A collection of short stories showing the moment when accidental encounters turn into magical ties. "Ju-Chan", who is trying to find the soul of a cat that left for heaven, and "Ji-Su", a mysterious girl who followed him. "Harry", who went on a trip after losing a beloved friend, and "Chie", a child who resembles that friend.

Contains:
1. **Yeoreum Anseseo** (여름 안에서)
2. **Panorama** (파노라마)

*Note: Gold Award winner in the 16th Japan International Manga Award.*
*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

If you take off the checkered shirt and thick rimmed glasses on his head, you get a handsome and young blond man?! The nerdy Ethan fell in love with Dwayne at their high school prom. With no progress for 4 years, Ethan reunites with Dwayne in his graduation party. Dwayne, ignoring Ethan who had mustered up his courage to go talk to him, feels something hard graze his hand as he walks past the nerdy boy. This guy has something amazing…! 

"You.. Do you wanna do something fun with me?"

What will happen to the nerdy boy, Ethan?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

In a poor rural village, there was a nameless boy who led a poor life without even knowing his parents.

description:
***Note:** Promotional oneshot for the novel.*

[Promotional Webtoon/Novel](https://page.kakao.com/content/54353806/viewer/55258659)

[Original Novel](https://page.kakao.com/content/54353806)

When I opened my eyes, I found my soul synced into the popular dating sim game, ‘Midnight’! And although I was clearly one of the female protagonists, I possessed the body of Evenes Harin, the saint who is treated like a trivial extra. What’s worse is that I must pursue one of the five male love interests and see it through to a happy ending in order to complete the game.

Having attended the triple combo of an all-girls middle school, high school, and university wasn’t enough of a debuff, having unintentionally put up an iron defense, I’ve been in ‘forever alone’ mode for 25 years. On top of that, I’ve possessed the Saint seldom played due to her atrociously difficult route! This life is screwed up, and I’m sure of it.

“The more you look at it, the more novel this situation is.”  
“...?”  
“How would you feel about living here like this?”

Boasting a 99.9999% probability of a bad ending: the obviously crazy Archmage.

“Evenes Harin.”  
“?”  
“Now I’m sure you serve the devil. Or are you really crazy?”

The epitome of rudeness: the seriously narcissistic Crown Prince.

“I’ve made up my mind.”  
“Shut up.”  
“I’ll make you into my first doll.”

Instead of wrinkles on his brain, it’s full of blooming flowers: the yandere Merchant Union’s director.

“...”  
“... Do you have something to say?”  
“(shakes head)”

At the level of a shadowy human, a man of few words: the underworld guild leader.

At the lowest level, the most ordinary one is the empire’s youngest swordmaster: the knight commander...

“Lady Saint.”  
“Yes.”  
“When I’m together with my Lady, my heart feels at ease.”  
“... Ah.”  
“I feel like I am one with Lunium.”

As you can see, he is a zealous follower of the Temple of Lunium.

“Would you not like to visit our house?”  
“... Your house?”  
“There is something that I would like to show you. Only to you.”

And even the duke’s daughter, who can be called the true heroine, is acting like this.

... Will I really be able to complete this game without any problems?

When humans try to play god there is always those who will resist.

As medical science advances there is a dramatic increase in the aging population and drastic world policy is adopted to curb population. All people are setwith a death age. To carry out the policy the Institute is established and as the Institute becomes a place of power, influential men begin to use it for their personal gain.

The poor are still unable to afford the medical advances that science has made. Joon-sung who lives with his mother and sister is one of these unfortunate poor. They cannot afford the cure for their mother’s terminal illness. As two orphaned children they are easy targets for human traffickers and Joon-sung’s sister is abducted. Joon-sung is filled with pain and rages against an unjust society. He vows to make it into the Institute and become a person whom people fear. The first thing he does is change his name to Ji-hoon as he embarks on a new life.

In Ji-hoon’s assignments he experiences the dark side of human nature and his distrust in humanity grows as he sees people’s evil up close and personal. Then unexpectedly, a man comes to him begging to be put to death instead of his wife. And rumors start of fly about Ji-hoon. He confronts Si-hyun, the source of the rumors and is shocked to learn that his sister who was presumed dead had been alive all this time. With this new information, Ji-hoon slowly changes and cannot focus on his job. His head is filled only with thoughts of his long lost sister.

Two young lovers live in a future where nuclear war has destroyed the planet and neo nazism has returned.

Earth exists in a state where mankind cannot survive due to the aftershocks of a great explosion. Naham sympathizers proceed with creating a new type of cyborg organization in order to survive. A laboratory researcher named Rana is a zealous believer in the nautical mile, which tests harder than anyone else to find a human who can carry Naham in order to survive. During the experiment, Rana finds herself to be the most suitable carrier, but does not want to dedicate herself to the Naham belief, and so she runs away with her beloved John during the experiment. John and Rana, who have fled together, are on the verge of death by the Naham’s that are chasing them. While on the run, John causes Rana to fall into a cold cave and then runs away, leaving her on her own before he dies resenting her in the icy mountainside.

Time passes, and John is reborn as a cyborg sent by the League of Freedom who asks Rana to meet and then join the League of Freedom, a robot federation that fights against the Nahams. The League of Freedom aims to defeat the Nahams and wake up a being named Mother Atlas in order to create a peaceful Earth. The League of Freedom, which must find the Great Divergence in order to counter the Nahams tell Rana that she has a great power that can save them all.

A family moves into a house in which strange things are happening, and a looming danger from underneath threatens to destroy them and everything they know.

Shin-hye’s family has bought a rural house in the heart of the countryside that had been vacant for a few years after an elderly couple who lived there suddenly went missing. Quickly both get comfortable enjoying their new house on a lake. Now their family will be able to spend more time away from the city where they can recover from their overworked hearts, bodies and minds. But one day, her husband starts to see and hear and complain that he is seeing some strange things, but Shin-hye turns a blind eye out of annoyance at her weak husband. Still, as she ignores his pleas, her husband continues to see ghosts and feel evil spirits moving throughout the house. Shin-hye, regardless of her husband’s complaints, has no intention of leaving the house and no matter what he says, she chooses not to believe him. A few days later, A Sinkhole… A huge hole that causes the ground to open up and implode into itself, swallows up the house, and as a result, Shin-hye loses her husband and son, all except for her daughter Kang-ji.

It takes her years to recover, even acquiring a mental illness after the incident. Concerned about this, her sisters brought her to live in a different place, all helping Shin-hye stay healthy, and also to raise her daughter Kang-ji. However, by the time Shin-hye returned to her peaceful days, strange things begin to happen again, and suddenly the evil spirit that her husband had seen began to stalk her as well.
